items.title: 3. Safe current (all inferred)
items.text:
Stepper rms currents with 0.5 ohm sense: irun 9, vsense 0 -> 0.138 A rms; irun 31, vsense 1 -> 0.245 A rms.

  • A 35BYJ46-class motor is tiny: 12 V / 130 ohm gives ~92 mA per phase DC; 300 ohm variants ~40-80 mA. Likely rated about 0.08-0.10 A per phase.
  • Even stock 0.138 A rms (0.195 A peak) is likely at or above that rating for a 130 ohm motor; 0.245 A rms is ~2.5x a typical rating -> expect heavy heating (can-stack coils of 130-300 ohm dissipate I^2R: 0.245^2 x 130 x 2 phases ~ 15 W worst case, vs ~5 W at 0.138 A; both far above what a 35 mm can sheds, and the blue plastic melts ~100-130 C). That is consistent with the melted housing.
  • Conclusion: yes, probably rated below 0.245 A, plausibly below 0.138 A. Do not use irun 31/vsense 1. Measure coil resistance first; if ~130 ohm, target <=0.1 A rms (irun ~6, vsense 0 -> ~0.09 A rms); stealthChop/idle current reduction (ihold low) recommended since feed motor idles most of the time. Temperature rise cannot be quantified from sources (no datasheet); treat as unknown, check by touch after short runs.
  • Note a 24 V supply on a 130 ohm motor is fine only because the TMC-type driver chops to current; the DC rating (12 V) is irrelevant to chopper drive, current is the limit.

items.title: Stock IFS v3.0.7: lane sensor ADC sampling timing
items.text: Static analysis of the stock ifs.bin (base 0x08010000): the Ghidra decompile plus a disassembly listing. Nothing was run on a printer. [V] = verified in code, [I] = inferred from code plus datasheet/SDK knowledge, [U] = uncertain/assumed.

items.title: 1. ADC clock tree and conversion
items.text: Init FUN_08011a2c (called from FUN_080111a0): - FUN_08011eac(0x18,1) RCC+0x18 (APB2PCLKEN) |= 0x18 (GPIOB, GPIOC clocks). FUN_08011e6c(0xe000,1) RCC+0x14 (AHBPCLKEN) |= 0xE000 = ADC2/ADC3/ADC4 clocks (bits 13..15; the 0x40020C00/0x40021800/0x40021C00 ADC bases match ADC2/3/4) [I for bit names]. - FUN_08010fa2(0,7) -> FUN_08011e48(0x100,0): RCC+0x2C (CFG2) &= 0xFFFFFE0F (ADCPLLPRES=0, ADCPLLEN bit8=0, PLL ADC clock OFF); FUN_08011e30(7): CFG2 [3:0] = 7 = ADCHPRES. [V] - ADCHCLK divider table at flash 0x08019EB4 (read from ifs.bin): 01 02 04 06 08 0a 0c 10 20 ..., index 7 = 0x10 = 16. Same table is used by the clock-reading routine FUN_08011ecc (param_1[5] = HCLK / table[CFG2 & 0xf]). So ADC clock = HCLK / 16 = 144 MHz / 16 = 9.0 MHz [V for /16, HCLK=144 MHz from the confirmed value]. - FUN_08011e14(0x20000, 0x3800): CFG2 &= 0xFFFF03FF | 0x20000 | 0x3800 = ADC1M source bit10=0 (HSI), ADC1MPRES bits[15:11]=7 (/8) -> 1 MHz reference (only for ADC power-up/cal). Bit 17 meaning [U]. Not part of the conversion rate. - ADC CTRL3 (+0x58) is never written (only read for RDY, flag 0x20). CKMOD (bit 4) stays at its reset value; with the PLL ADC clock disabled the ADC runs from ADCHCLK [I; the Kalico driver also clears CKMOD for the HCLK mode]. RES (CTRL3[1:0]) stays at reset = 12 bit [I]; values are compared with 4095-scale thresholds (0x3e9, 2999, 0xc1c = 3100) so 12 bit is consistent. - FUN_08011144 (per ADC): CTRL1 mode independent, scan off; CTRL2: continuous off, align right, EXTSEL = 0xE0000 (=7, software trigger); RSEQ1 length 1. Then ADON, wait RDY, CAL (CTRL2 bit2), wait cal done. [V] - Sample time: every read goes through FUN_080110dc(adc, ch) -> FUN_08010fcc(adc, ch, 1, 7): SAMPT (+0x10 for ch<10, +0xC for ch>=10) = 7 for the channel = 239.5 cycles (SDK enum ADC_SAMP_TIME_239CYCLES5 = 7), RSEQ3 slot1 = channel. [V code, SDK enum from kalico-ad5x n32g45x_adc.h] - Conversion = 239.5 + 12.5 = 252 ADC cycles (12.5 per 12 bit conversion from the SDK/Kalico comment, [I]) = 28.0 us at 9 MHz, plus under ~0.5 us for the register writes and flag clearing (about 70 core cycles) -> about 28.5 us per read [I]. - Trigger: software, single shot, blocking. FUN_080110dc: set sample time and sequence, FUN_080110aa(adc,1) = CTRL2 |= 0x500000 (EXTTRIG + SWSTART), poll STS (+0) bit1 (EOC) with no timeout, clear STS bits 1 and 4, return DAT (+0x4C) & 0xFFFF. No timer trigger, no DMA, no continuous mode, no ADC interrupt. [V]

items.title: 2. How one sample is collected in FUN_08015ea0
items.text:
• Main loop: uVar5++; if (uVar5 > 1000) { uVar5 = 0; <read all 8 inputs> } FUN_08017ad4(); (asm: cmp.w r0,#0x3e8; bls 0x08015fca, 0x08015fca: b 0x0801634a, 0x0801634a: bl 0x08017ad4, 0x0801634e: b 0x08015ec8). [V]
  • Inside one "round" the 8 inputs are read back to back, each a blocking FUN_080110dc, in this order: silk0 (ADC2 ch6), silk1 (ADC2 ch8), silk2 (ADC4 ch3), silk3 (ADC4 ch4), speed0 (ADC2 ch7), speed1 (ADC2 ch9), speed2 (ADC3 ch5), speed3 (ADC4 ch5). Only a few compares/stores between reads. One round = 8 x ~28.5 us = ~228 us (cannot overlap: each waits for EOC). [V order, I timing]
  • Each input has a counter 1..21: reads 1..20 add to the sum, read 21 stores avg = sum / 0x14 (20) and resets sum and counter; read 21 itself is not added. So one stored average = 21 rounds, with the 20 summed rounds spread over 20 x T_round. Samples are NOT taken back to back; consecutive samples of one channel are one full main-loop period (1001 passes) apart. [V]

items.title: 3. Main loop pass time and real time between averaged values
items.text:
Idle pass (no UART line pending, no flags), from the disassembly [V]: FUN_08017ad4 -> FUN_08015c54 -> loop test FUN_08017b60 (-> FUN_08015c24 -> FUN_0801496c: ring-buffer count = (size + head - tail) % size, one sdiv + mls) returns 0 -> return; then two byte flag tests (0x200000b9, 0x20000260). About 60 Thumb-2 instructions, about 11 call/return/branch refills, 1 sdiv, about 8 literal-pool loads from flash. No delay loop, no SysTick wait, no UART wait in this path. [V] - Count: roughly 100 core cycles if flash had no wait states = 0.7 us at 144 MHz [I]. - Flash latency: FUN_08012008 sets FLASH+0 (AC) &= ~3; |= 4 -> 4 wait states at 144 MHz [V]. Whether prefetch/cache is on is not set here (reset default, [U]). Effective pass time is therefore 0.7 us (ideal) to about 3.5 us (no prefetch, every fetch stalls); best single estimate about 1.5 us [U, biggest uncertainty]. - Interrupts steal time: TIM6 ISR every 156 us (vec_70 -> FUN_0801900c, idle case is a short switch), TIM5 ISR (vec_66 -> FUN_0801813c, idle ARR 1999 at 2 MHz = 1 ms, i.e. about 1 kHz, but it is a planner loop of up to 10 iterations), SysTick every 20 ms (4 short blocks), USART1 DMA/IDLE. Estimated 2-5 % of the CPU when idle [U]; much more while stepping (TIM5 step rate) [U]. - Blocking work in the main context: command handling FUN_08012de8 runs whole F-commands inline, some with TMC UART reads at 9600 baud (previous notes: F13 costs about 8 ms; the host sends F13 about once per second while printing). That pauses the ADC rounds about 8 ms per second (about 0.8 %). [V code exists, 8 ms from STOCK_STALL_LED.md B1] - Round period: T_round = 1001 x t_pass / (1 - ISR load) + 8 x 28.5 us.

case t_pass T_round one averaged value (21 rounds) min 0.7 us 0.9 ms 18 ms best estimate 1.5 us 1.8 ms 38 ms max 3.5 us 3.8 ms 80 ms

Measured from code: ADC clock, sample time, blocking structure, 228 us per round, 1001 passes, 21 rounds. Assumed: pass time (flash prefetch state, ISR load). The spread is about 4x and cannot be narrowed without a measurement (for example two F21 polls timed against value changes, not done).

items.title: 4. Consequence for the 50-entry odometer ring (SysTick 20 ms, FUN_080121bc)
items.text:
• FUN_080121bc copies avg[i] (0x20000144 + 2i) into the ring buf[k] every 20 ms. It does not trigger or wait for a new ADC value. avg[i] only changes when the 21st round completes. [V]
  • So with T_avg = 18-80 ms (best 38 ms): if T_avg > 20 ms, a SysTick tick sees the previous value again (fraction of fresh ticks about 20 ms / T_avg, e.g. about 50 % at 38 ms); only if T_avg < 20 ms (the optimistic end) would every tick see a fresh value (and some updates would be skipped). The ring therefore holds runs of repeated values in the likely case; the window still spans 50 ticks = 1.00 s, the threshold test (|buf[k] - buf[0]| >= 15) just sees changes up to one T_avg late. [V mechanism, U fraction]
  • Each stored value is itself the mean of 20 samples taken over about 20 x T_round (about 18-76 ms), a built-in low-pass.

items.title: Summary table
items.text: quantity value evidence certainty ADC clock 9 MHz (HCLK/16, PLL ADC clock off) CFG2 low nibble = 7, table 0x08019EB4[7] = 0x10 high (HCLK=144 MHz taken from your notes) Resolution 12 bit CTRL3 never written, 4095 scale medium Sample time code 7 = 239.5 cycles, all channels FUN_08010fcc(adc,ch,1,7) high Conversion time 252 cycles = 28.0 us (+~0.5 us overhead) SDK 12.5 + 239.5 medium Trigger software SWSTART, single, blocking poll on EOC, no DMA/IRQ FUN_080110dc, EXTSEL=7 high One round (8 inputs) about 228 us, back to back code order high (given conversion time) Pass of main loop (idle) 0.7 - 3.5 us, best 1.5 us asm count, flash 4 WS low Time between samples of one channel 0.9 - 3.8 ms, best 1.8 ms 1001 x t_pass + round low Time between averaged values 18 - 80 ms, best about 38 ms (21 rounds, 21st discarded) as above low SysTick ring input reuses last avg; repeats likely FUN_080121bc reads 0x20000144 high (mechanism)

items.title: STOCK IFS (v3.0.7) feed motor accel/decel, reverse engineered (read-only)
items.text: Sources: the Ghidra decompile and disassembly of the stock ifs.bin (base 0x08010000) and its initial RAM image (0x20000000..0x20000490). Nothing was run against any printer. Marks: [V] verified in decompile/disassembly, [I] inferred from structure (Marlin-1.1-like planner), [U] uncertain.

items.title: Answer in one paragraph
items.text: Feed = axis 0 (F10 L mm goes on axis 0 only), speed = S/60 mm/s. The planner is a Marlin trapezoid. Acceleration = 500 mm/s^2 = 171848 steps/s^2 (the literal 500, and the per-axis cap for axes 0 and 1 is also 500). The 700 in table 0x20000440 is NOT used by the planner. A lone F10/F11 block enters and exits at the 120 steps/s floor (0.349 mm/s), so the move is a plain 0 -> S -> 0 trapezoid at 500 mm/s^2. At the end of a move there is no further ramp: it just stops after the last step at 120 steps/s. F112 / planner reset stops instantly (no ramp) and then disables the driver.

items.title: 1. Axis and units (F10)
items.text:
• F10 handler 0x08012ed8: strchr for 'L' (0x4c) and 'S' (0x53), atof (FUN_08014908), float store to 0x200000e4 (L) and 0x200000ec (S) [V disasm 0x08012ed8-0x08012f4c; pool 0x080131e8 = 0x200000e4, 0x080131ec = 0x200000ec]. initial RAM: L = 0, S = 600.0.
  • F10 start state 10 of the TIM6 state machine FUN_0801900c calls FUN_080163bc(*0x200000e4, *0x200000ec) [V decompile]; F11 uses 0x200000e0 (L, stored negated) / 0x200000e8 the same way (decompile).
  • FUN_080163bc(s0 = dist_mm, s1 = speed_mm_min), disasm 0x080163bc-0x0801642c: zeroes position and a 5-float target array at 0x20000c98, then vstr s16,[0x20000c98] (dist goes to element 0 only), vdiv.f32 s1,s17,s0 with s0 = 60.0 (pool 0x0801649c = 0x42700000), then bl 0x08017b80 with r0 = 0x20000c98. So axis 0, speed = S/60 mm/s.
  • FUN_08017b80(speed_mm_s, target*) [V]: steps = round(target[i] * steps_per_mm[i]); steps_per_mm = (float)(0x2000032c[i] = 0x147c6375 = 343696245) / 1e6 (double 1e6 at 0x08018538) = 343.696245, stored at 0x20005ca4 + i*0x30 + 4. Mode mask 0x20000460 = 0x1f (initial RAM) -> all axes relative: new = prev + round(). N = round(dist * 343.696245). Per-axis mm delta 0x20001604[i] = delta * 0x20005da8[i] (= 1/steps_per_mm). Block step counts: A = |d0+d1| (block+4), B = |d0-d1| (block+8), Z (+0xc), E0 (+0x10), E1 (+0x14); step_event_count (block+0x18, RAM 0x20000310) = max of them = N for a feed move. Length 0x2000030c = sqrt(d0^2+d1^2+d2^2) = N/343.696 mm.
  • Speed cap: 0x20000340[i] = 30000 (axis 0), divided by double 60.0 (0x08018544) = 500 mm/s into 0x20005ca4 + i0x30 + 8. If speed|d_i|/len exceeds it the speed is reduced (decompile). Feedrate multiplier 0x20000070 = 1.0 (initial RAM 0x3f800000); 0x20000460 & 0x80 = 0 so no extra scaling [V].
  • Call into the planner (disasm 0x080180ac-0x080180be): FUN_08016540(s0 = 0x20000470 (mm/s), r0 = steps/s (overwritten later), r1 = *0x2000046c (= 0), r2 = 1, r3 = *0x2000046c).

items.title: 2. Block acceleration (block+0x74) in FUN_08016540
items.text: Decompile lines 6281-6411: 1. Extrude-only branch: if (block+4 == 0 && block+8 == 0 && block+0xc == 0): accel = ceil(steps_per_mm_of_move * 500.0) (float 500.0 at DAT_08016e54 = 0x43fa0000 [V]). Not taken for the feed (block+4 = N). 2. Otherwise: accel = ceil((float)500 * (N / len)) with the integer literal 500 (VectorSignedToFloat(500), line 6301) = ceil(500 * 343.696) = 171848 or 171849 depending on float rounding. [V] The RAM variable 0x200002ec (500) is not read here. 3. Advance branch (block+0x3f) needs an E delta (iVar12 != 0): never for the feed. block+0x3d = 0x2000046c = 0. 0x20000304 (initial RAM 0; 0.04 for [0],[1] from FUN_080171c0) is only the linear-advance K, unused. 4. Per-axis cap loop (lines 6348-6409): for axes 0..3 with block steps != 0 (A and B): accel = min(accel, cap[i] * step_event_count / steps_i), cap[i] = 0x200015a0[i]. N/N = 1, so accel = cap = 171848.1 -> (uint) 171848. 5. 0x200015a0[i] = (float)0x200015c8[i] * steps_per_mm[i] (FUN_080171c0 lines 6596-6601). 0x200015c8 = {500, 500, 50, 500, 500} written in FUN_08018dbc (lines 7863-7867; the 0x497ffff0/steps_per_mm = 3051 clamp is not hit). No other writer found. Init chain: boot -> FUN_080164a4 (line 5709) -> FUN_08018dbc -> FUN_080171c0. 6. 0x20000440 {700, 350, 600, 100000, 100000} (initial RAM) is only read in FUN_08018264 to fill 0x20005ca4 + i*0x30 + 0x10/+0x14 (= +-accel*steps/mm, halved for axes 0,1). No reader of those two fields was found in the decompile, so for the feed it is dead data [V no reader found; U for a reader through an unseen alias]. The earlier "700" in STOCK_MOTOR_DRIVE.md is wrong for the planner. 7. Stored: block+0x74 = accel (steps/s^2); block+0x5c = accel / (N/len) = 499.9996 mm/s^2; block+0x38 = (uint)(accel * 8.388608) = 1441565 (double 8.388608 = 2^24/2e6 in the pool at 0x08016e74) [V].

items.title: 3. Effective acceleration, entry/exit
items.text:
Effective acceleration: 500 mm/s^2 (499.9996), 171848 steps/s^2, for F10 and F11, both directions. Not 700.

Lone block (every F10/F11, because the state machine waits for an empty queue: states 0xb, 0xf, 0x16, ...): - New block entry_speed^2 (block+0x50) = 0.0025 (DAT_08017110 [V disasm 0x08017088]) = 0.05 mm/s. Reverse pass FUN_08017648 loops while (prev(head) != planned_ptr); with one block both are equal so the body never runs [V]. Forward pass FUN_0801735c(NULL, ...) does nothing [V]. Junction jerk (0x2000158c = {10,10,0.3,20,20} mm/s, line 6591) only feeds block+0x54 (max_entry) and is not applied to a lone block. - Tail of FUN_08017430 (disasm 0x080175a0-0x080175aa) calls FUN_080158d0(entry = sqrt(entry^2)/nominal, exit = 0.05/nominal); 0.05 is the literal at 0x0801763c = 0x3d4ccccd [V]. - FUN_080158d0 [V decompile 5290-5378]: initial = ceil(nominal_rate * entry), final = ceil(nominal_rate * exit), both clamped to >= 0x78 = 120 steps/s. So initial = final = 120 steps/s = 0.349 mm/s. accelerate_steps = ceil((nominal^2 - initial^2) / (2 accel)) (FUN_08015bf0 = (p2^2 - p1^2) / (2 p3)), decelerate_steps = floor((nominal^2 - final^2) / (2 accel)), plateau = N - acc - dec; if negative: acc = ceil((2 accel N - init^2 + final^2) / (4 accel)) clamped to [0, N], plateau 0. Stored: block+0x30 accelerate_until, +0x34 decelerate_after = acc + plateau, +0x6c initial_rate, +0x70 final_rate. That FUN_08014660 / FUN_080146e0 / FUN_08014548 are ceil / floor / ceil comes from their bodies [I]. - nominal_rate (block+0x64) = ceil(N * speed / len) = ceil(343.696 * speed) (lines 6243-6248). - Queue slowdown (lines 6213-6224, 0x200002fc = 4) only acts when more than 1 block is already queued: not for a lone block. - Consecutive F10 commands are separate stop/start blocks; no junction speed ever applies.

items.title: 4. Tick routine and stops
items.text:
• TIM5 update IRQ = vec_66 0x080124d8 -> FUN_08015ba4 -> FUN_0801813c (scheduler) -> FUN_080177a8 (step) and FUN_080152a4 (next interval). TIM5 registers touched: +0x2c ARR (FUN_080126cc), +0x24 CNT, +0x14 EGR, +0x0c DIER [V]. After an update event the counter restarts, so period = ARR + 1 ticks [I].
  • Tick unit: FUN_08015768 sets TIM5 prescaler = 144e6 / 4e6 - 1 = 35; the planner interval is 2,000,000 / rate (FUN_080158b4), i.e. the design clock is 2 MHz = 72 MHz timer clock (FUN_08012008 sets CFG |= 0x500, PPRE1 = /4, timers x2) / 36. [U] The timer clock is not proven to be 72 MHz. If it were 144 MHz, TIM5 would run 4 MHz and every step interval would be half, i.e. all speeds 2x S. Idle poll ARR = 1999 gives 1 kHz, not the "2 kHz" in older notes (which assume 4 MHz). By the same reasoning TIM6 (selector) would be 72 MHz / 72 / 156 = 6410 Hz toggle rate, not 12820 [U].
  • One step per event: FUN_080158b4 sets 0x200002a8 = 1 on every call; FUN_080177a8 loops 0x200002a8 times over FUN_080188bc(0); only axis 0 is ever stepped (disasm 0x08017906-0x08017908: movs r0,#0; bl 0x080188bc). Bresenham with steps == N gives exactly one pulse per event: STEP pin high then low (FUN_08018798(0,1), (0,0)) on PA0 [V], DIR via FUN_0801856c. The pulse is skipped (and motion flags 0x20000428/2d cleared) if 0x2000019c != 0 with the dir flag set (initial RAM 0x2000019c = 0) [I].
  • Per event (FUN_080152a4, Marlin ISR) [V]: block load sets acc_time = dec_time = 0, acc_step_rate = initial, first interval = 2e6 / initial = 16666 ticks (8.33 ms) before step 1. After each step (completed already incremented):
  • completed <= accelerate_until: rate = mulh(acc_time, accel_rate) + initial, capped at nominal; interval = 2e6 / rate; acc_time += interval.
  • completed > decelerate_after: r = mulh(dec_time, accel_rate); rate = acc_step_rate - r floored at final (final if r >= acc_step_rate); dec_time += interval.
  • otherwise cruise: interval = 2e6 / nominal. mulh = FUN_08011d34 = (a*b + 0x800000) >> 24. rate = t * accel in steps/s exactly (8.388608 * t_ticks / 2^24 = t_ticks / 2e6).
  • End of block: last step, block dropped, next block loaded or idle interval 2000 ticks; EN is not touched. So the move ends with the decel ramp down to 120 steps/s then an instant stop from 0.349 mm/s. There is no extra stop code in the F10/F11 path.
  • F112 (FUN_08015d28): FUN_08017968 clears DIER bit 0 (TIM5 update IRQ off), moves head/planned/next pointers to tail (queue emptied), sets current block pointer 0x20000264 = 0, resyncs positions, re-enables the IRQ; then PA5 high (feed driver disabled) and PB1 high. A mid-move F112 is therefore an IMMEDIATE stop (no ramp, steps cease at whatever rate), and the driver is released. The F11 end state calls the same routine. F24/F39/F18/F30/F15 do not reset the planner.

items.title: 5. Simulation results
items.text:
extra_tick=1 adds the +1 tick of ARR+1 per step [U].

move nominal accel until decel after time to cruise ramp distance total (extra 0 / 1) ideal Klipper a=500 50 mm S1200 (20 mm/s) 6874 st/s step 138 (0.401 mm) step 17048 of 17185 47.7 ms (rate hits nominal at step 132, 0.384 mm) 0.40 mm 2.535 s / 2.544 s 2.540 s 50 mm S600 (10 mm/s) 3437 st/s step 35 (0.102 mm) step 17151 of 17185 27.6 ms (step 29, 0.084 mm) 0.10 mm 5.017 s / 5.026 s 5.020 s

A Klipper trapezoid with max accel 500 mm/s^2, cruise S/60, start/end velocity about 0 reproduces stock within 0.2% (0.5% if the ARR+1 tick is real). The 8.3 ms first interval and up to 1 ms block pickup latency are not modelled.

import struct, math

def f32(x): return struct.unpack('<f', struct.pack('<f', x))[0]
def rnd(x): return int(math.floor(x + 0.5)) if x >= 0 else -int(math.floor(-x + 0.5))

TIMER_HZ   = 2_000_000                 # FUN_080158b4: 0x1e8480 / rate (TIM5 = 72 MHz timer clock / 36) [U clock]
SPM_D      = 343696245 / 1e6           # RAM 0x2000032c (0x147c6375) / 1e6 (double 1e6 at 0x08018538)
SPM        = f32(SPM_D)                # 0x20005ca4 + 4
INV_SPM    = f32(1.0 / SPM)            # 0x20005da8
ACCEL_MM   = 500                       # literal 500 in FUN_08016540 (also 0x200015c8[0] and [1])
CAP        = f32(float(ACCEL_MM) * SPM)  # 0x200015a0[0] = (float)0x200015c8[0] * steps/mm
MIN_RATE   = 0x78                      # FUN_080158d0
MIN_PLANNER_SPEED_SQR = f32(0.0025)    # DAT_08017110 / DAT_0801763c = 0.05 mm/s

def mulh(a, b):                        # FUN_08011d34 (MultiU24X24toH16 with rounding)
    return (a * b + 0x800000) >> 24

def calc_timer(rate):                  # FUN_080158b4
    return (TIMER_HZ // rate) & 0xffff

def plan(dist_mm, s_mm_min):
    v = f32(s_mm_min / 60.0)                              # FUN_080163bc /60.0 ; 0x20000070 = 1.0
    n = abs(rnd(f32(f32(dist_mm) * SPM)))                 # FUN_08017b80 round(target*steps/mm)
    d = f32(n * INV_SPM)                                  # 0x20001604[0]
    ln = f32(math.sqrt(d * d))                            # block+0x58
    inv = f32(1.0 / ln)
    f19 = f32(v * inv)
    nom_sqr = f32(f32(f32(ln * f19) * ln) * f19)          # block+0x4c
    nom_rate = int(math.ceil(f32(n * f19)))               # block+0x64
    spm_blk = f32(n * inv)                                # steps per mm of this block
    acc = int(math.ceil(f32(ACCEL_MM * spm_blk)))         # ceil(500 * steps/mm)
    if float(acc) > CAP:                                  # per-axis cap loop (axes A and B)
        acc = int(f32(f32(CAP * n) / n))
    acc_mm = f32(acc / spm_blk)                           # block+0x5c
    acc_rate = int(acc * 8.388608)                        # block+0x38
    nom = f32(math.sqrt(nom_sqr))
    ent_f = f32(f32(math.sqrt(MIN_PLANNER_SPEED_SQR)) * f32(1.0 / nom))   # lone block: entry = exit = 0.05 mm/s
    ini = max(MIN_RATE, int(math.ceil(f32(nom_rate * ent_f))))
    fin = ini
    def dist(a, b, ac): return 0.0 if ac == 0 else f32(f32(b * b - a * a) / f32(ac * 2.0))   # FUN_08015bf0
    acc_steps = int(math.ceil(dist(ini, nom_rate, acc)))
    dec_steps = int(math.floor(dist(nom_rate, fin, -acc)))
    plateau = n - acc_steps - dec_steps
    if plateau < 0:
        x = f32(f32(f32(f32(acc * 2.0 * n) - ini * ini) + fin * fin) / f32(acc * 4.0))
        x = math.ceil(x)
        acc_steps = n if max(x, 0) >= n else int(max(x, 0))
        plateau = 0
        dec_after = acc_steps
    else:
        dec_after = acc_steps + plateau
    return dict(n=n, nom_rate=nom_rate, acc=acc, acc_mm=acc_mm, acc_rate=acc_rate, ini=ini, fin=fin,
                acc_until=acc_steps, dec_after=dec_after)

def run(b, extra_tick=0):
    """FUN_080152a4 + FUN_0801813c. Returns step times in seconds and the rates used."""
    t = calc_timer(b['ini'])                 # first interval (block load)
    acc_time = dec_time = 0
    acc_rate_now = b['ini']
    done = 0
    clock = 0
    times = []
    rates = []
    while True:
        clock += t + extra_tick              # wait, then step
        done += 1
        times.append(clock / TIMER_HZ)
        if done >= b['n']:
            break
        if b['acc_until'] < done:
            if b['dec_after'] < done:        # decelerate
                r = mulh(dec_time, b['acc_rate'])
                if r < acc_rate_now:
                    r = acc_rate_now - r
                    if r < b['fin']: r = b['fin']
                else:
                    r = b['fin']
                t = calc_timer(r)
                dec_time += t
            else:                            # cruise
                r = b['nom_rate']; t = calc_timer(r)
        else:                                # accelerate
            r = mulh(acc_time, b['acc_rate']) + b['ini']
            if r > b['nom_rate']: r = b['nom_rate']
            acc_rate_now = r
            t = calc_timer(r)
            acc_time += t
        rates.append(r)
    return times, rates

if __name__ == '__main__':
    for s in (1200, 600):
        b = plan(50.0, s)
        for extra in (0, 1):
            times, rates = run(b, extra)
            tc = next(i for i, r in enumerate(rates) if r >= b['nom_rate'])
            print(f"S{s} 50mm extra_tick={extra}: {b}")
            print(f"  time to cruise {times[tc]*1000:.2f} ms at step {tc+1} = {(tc+1)/SPM_D:.3f} mm;"
                  f" decel starts step {b['dec_after']} ({b['dec_after']/SPM_D:.3f} mm);"
                  f" total {times[-1]*1000:.2f} ms; ideal trapezoid {50/(s/60)+(s/60)/500:.4f} s")

items.title: Stock firmwareExe: when does the host stop/release the IFS feed motor
items.text: Source: Ghidra static analysis of the stock firmwareExe. Addresses are function entry points. Wire format: F<cmd> C<chn> L<len> S<speed>; status reply is parsed by splitting on [: ], field 3 = state (5 = move done, 0x7f = error, 0x7e = busy/timeout). All IFS traffic goes through SerialObject::sendCmdToUart4 (005e3230), mutex-serialised.

items.title: 1. Every F112 sender (the only literal "F112" refs)
items.text:
Function Addr When SerialObject::checkLoad 005fbaa0 state==5 AND toolhead sensor (checkFilamentSenser) true -> F112. Not sent on its timeout/error/cancel returns. SerialObject::checkFeeding 005f9674 (a) state==5 and flag this+0x8a set -> F112 (ret 7); (b) toolhead sensor tripped -> F112 (ret 0); (c) cancel flag (this+0x2e3) set -> F112 (ret 1). NOT sent on: error 0x7f (ret 8), 0x7e x100 (ret 10), double 30 s timeout (ret 3, sends F39 instead). SerialObject::fourInOneLoadFristStep 005f839c after the F10 poll loop ends (sensor trip, or >=0x78 polls) -> F112, then LoadSecondStep. NOT sent on 0x7e (ret 10) or cancel (ret 1) exits. SerialObject::checkRefullingFrist 005f2478 toolhead sensor cleared during unload -> F112 (resent if reply lacks "ok"). Not sent if state 5 persists >10 polls (ret 4), 0x7f (8), 0x7e (10), cancel. Filament::fourInOneLoadFristStep 00592534 UI load wizard, F112 after loop. Filament::doFFMUnload 00594f60 UI unload wizard, F112 after the F11 poll loop. FourToOne::on_f112_clicked 0079f2ac debug button only.

No other F112 sender exists. No F112 on print end, pause, cancel (stopFilament 005e3888 only sets flag +0x2e3), idle, or periodically.

items.title: 2. Is F112 always sent / keep-alive
items.text:
• Unload F11 paths never send F112: SerialObject::fourInOneUnLoad (005f616c), cutFilament (005f5e58), doLoadAndUnload's F11 (005fda70), Filament::checkUnLoad (005930b4). They poll F13 until state 5 and return; motor left as firmware leaves it.
  • LoadSecondStep (005f7b4c): F11 C<n> L100 S1200, polls F13 every 200 ms until state 5, returns with NO F112. So after every auto-insert the last motor command is an F11 with no F112 (checkFourInOneLoad 005fa288 then sends F23 C<n> and checkCrotchF39 = F39 C<n>; neither is F112).
  • All error/timeout/cancel exits listed above leave F10/F11 motor on without F112.
  • Idle polling: thread SerialObject::recvQueryFourInOneSt (005fa660) loops F13; usleep 200 ms when main machine status==0 (idle), sleep 1 s otherwise, and 1 s waits while a load/unload holds flag +0x2f0. 4 failed replies -> sigIfsStatus(false). It never sends F112/F39. Only F13 and F19 pass sendCmdToUart4 when this+0x2e2==0.
  • F19: only from MachineInfo (initWidget 006eb3c8, slotCheckifs, doUpdateIfs): on demand, no period found.
  • F23 C1..C4 batch: clearChnStatus 005e3584 (caller not traced).

items.title: 3. Sequences (literals as in binary; numbers from decompile)
items.text:
(a) Auto/first insert (recvQueryFourInOneSt -> checkFourInOneLoad, per channel with sensor bit): F24 C<n> (checkCrotchCutting 005f4f8c, poll F13 1 s up to ~21x) ; F10 C<n> L650 S1200 (0x28a, 0x4b0) ; poll F13 every 100 ms until toolhead sensor / ~12 s ; F112 ; F11 C<n> L100 S1200 ; poll F13 200 ms to state 5 ; F23 C<n> ; F39 C<n> (checkCrotchF39 005f8da0, polls F13 1 s up to 11x). On 0x7f: F15 then re-send F10/F11. Pause auto-load (checkPauseAutoLoad 005fade4): F24, F10 C<n> L200 S.., F13 polls, F23 C<n>, F39 C<n>.

(b) Toolchange load during print (doLoadAndUnload 005fda70, old->new): cutFilament(old) (G1 E-.., F11 C<old> L60 S..) ; checkRefullingFrist(old) (F13 1 s poll, F112 when toolhead clear) ; F11 C<old> L50 S.. ; F39 C<old> ; F24 C<new> ; F10 C<new> L1000 S<spd> ; checkFeeding(new) (F13 100 ms poll, up to 30 s, F112 on toolhead sensor; at 30 s: F11 C<new> L.. S1200 retry, second 30 s: error + F39) ; M400. Error 0x7f: F15 + F24 + retry.

(c) Unload (checkPrintUnLoad 005f6e58 / fourInOneUnLoad 005f616c): F23 C<n> ; F24 C<n> ; F11 C<n> S600 ; M400 ; poll F13 200 ms ; on state 5 repeated F11 C<n> L70 S.. x3 then F11 C<n> L60 S.. ; cutFilament. No F112 at all.

(d) Channel switch (changeChannel 005fe970): doLoadAndUnload as (b); cleanFilamentBox (005fce9c) ends with F23 C<n>; moves F800/F12000 are printer gcode.

Not found: exact S values for several F10/F11 calls (runtime/config), F19 period, caller of clearChnStatus.

items.title: Stock AD5X touchscreen: filament Load / Unload wizard for an IFS lane
items.text:
Source: static analysis of the stock firmwareExe (Ghidra 12.2). Addresses are entry points or instruction addresses of the decompile/disassembly. Literals were read from the binary's string data. Not repeated here (see Stock host spec): section 3 primitives (printClearGoPos, fourInOneCut, checkCrotchCutting, checkCrotchF39, cutFilament, flush pieces), section 2 type tables, error table. Wire format F<cmd> C<chn> L<len> S<speed>; F13 reply split on [: ], empty tokens skipped: tok3 = FFS_state (5 done, 0x7f error, 0x7e busy/timeout), tok5 = silk_state (lane sensor bitmask, bit n-1 = lane n), tok9 = ffs_channels_insert, tok11 = stall_state (odometer bitmask).

Class fields used by Filament:: (this): +0x14 SerialObject, +0x1c running flag (cleared by Cancel; every wait loop exits on 0), +0x28 last lane-sensor mask (tok5), +0x38 operation (1 load, 2 unload), +0x40 selected lane (0 = non-IFS right extruder, 1..4 = IFS lane).

items.title: 0. Two different "load" paths
items.text:
1. Auto-insert (user pushes filament into the lane inlet, lane sensor trips): SerialObject::checkFourInOneLoad 005fa288 -> fourInOneLoadFristStep 005f839c (F10 C<n> L650 S1200, 100 ms polls, max 120 polls) -> fourInOneLoadSecondStep 005f7b4c (F11 C<n> L100 S1200) -> F23 C<n> -> F39 C<n>. No heat, no extruder, no G-code. Fully documented in STOCK_SPEC_HOST.md 5.1 and STOCK_HOST_RELEASE.md; it is "Step A" of the request. While it runs Filament::checkAutoLoadFilament 005899c4 blocks the wizard with the dialog "auto loading, please wait..." (and "Please pause the print." if a print is running).
  2. Touchscreen wizard "Load" (this file): one button runs everything from heating to purge. Its three on-screen steps are the labels set in on_buttonLoad_clicked 00596310 / on_btnLoad_clicked 005969f0: Heating -> Push -> Clear. Unload labels (on_buttonunLoad_clicked 00596520): Heating -> Cut -> withdraw. There is no separate "insert to sensor" screen and no "did the filament come out of the nozzle?" confirmation dialog anywhere in Filament:: (no such string; not found). The only user-facing UI hint is the static text "Select the slot and click feed to load the wire material." (string 00adddc0).

items.title: 1. How the wizard starts
items.text:
• on_btnLoad_clicked 005969f0: checkAutoLoadFilament() (abort if auto-load running or print not paused) -> showEditWidget(false) (type/colour edit page). on_buttonLoad_clicked 00596310: doEdit() (writes FilamentType<n> / FilamentColor<n> for lane n into config via Config::setFilamentType1..4/Color1..4), set labels Heating/Push/Clear, disableButtonItem(false), doFilament(). Unload: on_buttonunLoad_clicked 00596520 same with +0x38 = 2.
  • doFilament 0058c3ec: +0x1c = 1, stepOne (step icon 1), MainWindow::setOperationFilament(true), if not printing setMainMachineStatus(1,1), SerialObject::setFourInOneBusy(true) (silences the status poller), system("echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches"), then createThread(pthreadDoChangeFilament, stack 0x40000).
  • pthreadDoChangeFilament 00595cb0: +0x38 == 1 -> doLoad; == 2 -> doUnload; then sig_setpThreeFinished -> slot_setpThreeFinished 00591780 / stepCompelte 0059145c (cool-down, section 5).
  • doLoad 00593f58: lane +0x40 < 1 -> doIpdLoad 00591e58 (non-IFS extruder; see 6), else doFFMLoad 00593974.

items.title: 2. LOAD, lane to head: Filament::doFFMLoad 00593974 (lane n = +0x40)
items.text:
In order:

  1. updateFilamentTemp(n) 0058b828 -> target (section 3). G M104 S<target> (string "M104 S" 00addb9c at 00593a0c; sendGcodeCmd(...,1,0,0,0)). M104, not M109, no fan, no bed.
  2. If MainWindow::getHomeCompleted() == 0: SerialObject::homeManager(...) (00593ccc call site). If +0x1c == 0 return.
  3. printClearGoPos(LeftExtruderXOffset, LeftExtruderYOffset) 005ed008 -> G1 X<x+52.5> F12000, G1 Y220 F12000, G1 Y<y+229> F3000, M400 (literals 005ed0bc..005ed238). The head parks at the purge chute while heating.
  4. sig_showCancelBtn. checkheating() 00591a18: loop sleep(1); reads MainWindow::getNozzleRightRealTemp/TargetTemp, emits sig_tempE(real,target); done when 0 < target && target <= real <= target + 19 (0x13); returns 0 (abort) if +0x1c == 0. No timeout. Target value is the M104 above (read back from Klipper).
  5. sig_setpOneFinished (UI step 2 "Push"). SerialObject::setPauseAutoLoad(true).
  6. Old-filament check, only if Print::instPrint == 0 or Config::getFFMEnable() != 0: checkFilamentSenser() (Klipper GET_FILAMENT_VALUE, parse "value:" float, 005f1b44) true means filament in the toolhead:
  7. cur = Config::getChannel() (1 if 0). cutFilament(cur, x, y) 005f5e58 (cutter moves, G92 E0, IFS F11 C<cur> L60 S<UnloadSpeed> + G1 E-60 F<UnloadSpeed>, see spec 3.2/3.5). Then checkUnLoad(cur,false) (section 2a).
  8. result != 0: for lanes 1..4 with bit set in +0x28 and != cur: checkUnLoad(lane,true) until one returns 0. If none: 2 -> sig_extruderSensorAbort (E0113 dialog, wizard ends); 10 -> sig_ifsHomeError (E0114, "IFS home anomaly!"/"IFS home error!"); other -> sig_ifsError (E0108 dialog slot_operationError 00589c3c: "Failed to feed filament to the extruder!" + wiki link ...#e0108-failed-to-feed-filament-to-the-extruder). In practice checkUnLoad returns only 0/2/10, so E0108 is reached only through Filament::emitShowError 0058a9b4.
  9. result 0: updateCurve3, sig_showLine, continue.
  10. sensor empty (or print with FFM disabled): sig_showLine, continue.
  11. Lane feed: Filament::fourInOneLoadFristStep(n) 00592534 (section 2b). Then sig_setpTwoFinished (UI step 3 "Clear").
  12. If it returned 0: SerialObject::cleanFilamentBox(n, 0, x, y, false) 005fce9c = the purge (section 2c); G M400 (00593dbc); Config::setChannel(n). If it returned 2 nothing more happens (no dialog, wizard just ends).

items.title: 2a. Filament::checkUnLoad(lane, clamp) 005930b4 (retract the old lane clear of the head)
items.text:
• if clamp: checkCrotchCutting(lane) (F24) and IFS F11 C<lane> L60 S1200 (005931b0, S = 0x4b0).
  • G M400 (00593258). Loop (exits 0 when +0x1c == 0): IFS F13; state (tok3):
  • 5 and first time: IFS F11 C<lane> L60 S1200 again (005934c0), mark done; 5 second time: return 2 if checkFilamentSenser still true else 0.
  • 0x7f: F15, checkCrotchCutting(lane), F11 C<lane> L100 S1200 (00593690).
  • 0x7e: return 10.
  • sleep(1) per turn, no timeout.

items.title: 2b. Filament::fourInOneLoadFristStep(lane) 00592534 (lane filament to the toolhead sensor)
items.text:
1. checkCrotchCutting(lane) (F24 C, polls up to ~21 s, spec 3.3).
  2. IFS F10 C<lane> L1000 S1200 (literals "F10 C" 00addbc8, " L1000 S" 00addbd0, S = 0x4b0 = 1200 mm/min = 20 mm/s; call 00592600). No sensor pre-check (the auto path has one).
  3. Loop while +0x1c != 0: IFS F13 (00592a38), then
  4. tok11 (stall_state) == 0: counter++, return 2 once the counter exceeds 45 (0x2d) (odometer shows no movement; counter is never reset).
  5. tok3 == 5: leave loop.
  6. tok3 == 0x7f: F15, checkCrotchCutting(lane), resend F10 C<lane> L1500 S1200 (00592c14, " L1500 S" 00addbf4).
  7. checkFilamentSenser() true: leave loop.
  8. sleep(1).
  9. IFS F112 (00592d98). Return 0. (Also reached on Cancel.) No back-off F11, no F23/F39 here (those come in the purge). Max feed in one go is 1000 mm (50 s at 20 mm/s) or 1500 mm after a recover; there is no time limit other than the 45-poll stall rule.

items.title: 2c. Purge: cleanFilamentBox(n, 0, x, y, false) 005fce9c, then M400
items.text: Sequence (details and literals in STOCK_SPEC_HOST.md 3.10; call order verified at 005fcf60..005fd174): 1. G G1 X<x+52.5> F12000, G1 Y<y+229> F3000, M400. 2. flushFilamentFrist 005fc930: M106 S<fan1>, G92 E0, G1 E90 F<feed1>, IFS F10 C<n> L90 S<feed1> (005fcba4/005fcbb4), checkLoad(n, feed1) 005fbaa0 (F13 1 s polls; state 5 + toolhead sensor -> F112; F10 ... L30/L50/L600 recoveries; F39 after 6 polls; timeouts raise sigIFSError(E0100+n-1) "load timeOut!"), checkCrotchF39(n), M400, M106 S<fan2>. 3. flushFilamentBrush(false): 3 s dwell, three Y wipes G1 Y220 F12000/G1 Y<y+229> F3000, G1 X<x+52.5> F12000, G1 Y<y+229> F3000, M400. 4. flushFilamentSecond(n): M106 S<fan1>, 3 s dwell, G92 E0, G1 E90 F<feed2>, M400, M106 S<fan2>. 5. flushFilamentBrush(true): 3 s dwell, G92 E0, G1 E-3 F300, M400, G92 E0, wipes. 6. IFS F23 C<n> (005fd160). Total extruder push 180 mm (2 x G1 E90), speeds/fans from the type tables (PLA: F300, fan 0 then 125). Quirk: the type used for feed/fan is Config::getChannel() and in doFFMLoad Config::setChannel(n) is called AFTER the purge, so the tables use the previously loaded lane's type (00593da4 before 00593e08).

items.title: 3. Nozzle temperature (Filament::updateFilamentTemp 0058b828, used by load and unload)
items.text:
Type string = Config::getFilamentType<n>() of the selected lane (case 0..4; set by the edit page). Exact-string compare (decoded from the nested ifs):

type M104 S PLA, PLA-CF 220 (0xdc) SILK 230 (0xe6) TPU 250 (0xfa) PA, PC-ABS 270 (0x10e) PET-CF, PPS-CF, PC 280 (0x118) PA-CF 290 (0x122) PAHT-CF 305 (0x131) anything else (PETG, ABS, ASA, ...) 230 (0xe6)

This differs from getFilamentTypeTemp (220/230/250, end-of-print purge only).

items.title: 4. UNLOAD wizard: doUnload 00595a4c -> doFFMUnload 00594f60
items.text:

doFFMUnload: 1. setPauseAutoLoad(true). Filament::unLoadCut 0058b2a8 (own copy of the cutter): M400, G90, G1 Y10 F18000, G1 Y<CutYOffset-7.5> F1800, G1 X20 F12000 (two spaces), G1 X<CutXOffset-2.5> F600, M400, G92 E0, G1 E-5 F600, M400 (literals 0058b308..0058b700; offsets as in spec 3.2). 2. printClearGoPos(LeftExtruderXOffset, LeftExtruderYOffset). 3. haveFil = getE0Filament() (toolhead sensor reads filament). lane = haveFil ? Config::getChannel() : selected n. 4. checkCrotchCutting(lane) (F24). G G92 E0 (waited). G G1 E-60 F600 (005950d4, 600 literal, not waited, sendGcodeCmd(...,0,...): the extruder retract runs in parallel with the lane retract). 5. Filament::fourInOneUnLoad(lane,false) 005946b8: IFS F11 C<lane> L130 S1200 (0059479c, " L130 S"), G M400, poll F13 every 1 s: state 5 -> return 0 if the toolhead sensor is clear, or 0 if the lane's sensor bit (tok5) is still set, else 5; 0x7f -> F15, checkCrotchCutting, resend F11 C<lane> L100 S1200 (00594c9c); 0x7e -> return 10 -> sig_ifsHomeError (E0114) and stop. Ends when +0x1c == 0. 6. sig_setpTwoFinished (step 3 "withdraw"). If the toolhead had filament: checkCrotchCutting(selected n) (F24). 7. IFS F11 C<n> L1000 S1200 (0059518c, " L1000 S"; withdraws the selected lane). Poll F13 every 1 s; stop when state 5 or when the lane's silk bit (tok5 of the reply, stored to +0x28) is 0 (lane empty); 0x7f: up to 2 times F15, checkCrotchCutting(n), resend F11 C<n> L1000 S1200; 0x7e: dialog E0114: IFS home error! (SerialObject::emitShowError) and stop. 8. checkCrotchF39(n) (F39 C<n>), IFS F112 (005956c8). Then stepCompelte. No F23 in this wizard; the IFS is not told to re-select.

items.title: 5. Finish and cool-down (stepCompelte 0059145c / slot_setpThreeFinished 00591780, runs after load, unload, error and cancel)
items.text:
• If Print::instPrint == 0: G M106 S0 (0059168c), G M18 (005916dc, steppers off), setMainMachineStatus(0,1).
  • SerialObject::setNozzleHeat(0) 005ef978 -> G M104 S0 (or M104 S0 T0 when the nozzle reads below -10 C; with the +0xd0 flag it also clears +0x185).
  • setOperationFilament(false), setFourInOneBusy(false), buttons re-enabled, stopFilament(false) (clears cancel flag), status upload (6 = completed ok if not cancelled), QTimer::singleShot(5000, delayTime). No fan-down delay, no F39/F23/F112 here.

items.title: 6. Retry, error and cancel branches
items.text:
• Retry on IFS error: only the 0x7f (home/driver error) loop: F15, F24, resend the same F10/F11 (L1500 for the lane feed, L100 for retract recoveries, L1000 for withdraw; max 2 resends in the withdraw loop, unlimited in the others). 0x7e returns 10/E0114.
  • No automatic retry of the head load itself, no user "filament out?" question. The only repetition is the purge's own checkLoad loops (spec 3.9).
  • Errors: E0113 (sig_extruderSensorAbort, filament still in head after retract; text starts "Material is detected in the extruder, ..."), E0114 (sig_ifsHomeError), E0108 (sig_ifsError -> slot_operationError), slotIFSError 0058a520 (QString from SerialObject::sigIFSError, E0100+n-1 etc.): ConfirmDialog; and stopFilament(true) when not printing (aborts the wizard).
  • Cancel: on_btnCancel_clicked 0058bcac sets +0x1c = 0, uploadStatusToApp(3,0), stopFilament(true) (SerialObject+0x2e3). Loops exit; lane feed/withdraw send F112; stepCompelte still runs (M104 S0, M106 S0, M18). A cancel mid-purge returns through the flush functions' own cancel checks.
  • doIpdLoad 00591e58 (lane 0, non-IFS, for completeness): M104 S, home, printClearGoPos, checkheating, wait for sensor (getE0Filament, sleep(1)), M400, G92 E0, M106 S60, G1 E90 F300, M106 S255, sleep, clear_brush, printClearGoPos, G92 E0, M106 S60, G1 E90 F300, M106 S255, sleep, G92 E0, G1 E-3 F300, M400, clear_brush, printClearGoPos, home.
