items.title: Stock IFS motor drive vs our Kalico config (feed overheat check)
items.text: Sources: the Ghidra decompile of the stock ifs.bin (base 0x08010000) and its initial RAM image, and kalico-ad5x klippy/extras/tmc2209.py, tmc2130.py, tmc.py. Nothing was run against the printer.

items.title: 1. TMC register writes (stock)
items.text:
Writer: FUN_08019d1e(uart, reg, val) (sync 0x05, addr 0, reg|0x80, CRC8). Init function FUN_08011bc8(uart), called for USART2 (0x40004400, feed "jinsi") and UART7 (0x40015400, selector "qiehuan") with identical values. Writes, in order:

Reg Value Decode GCONF 0x00 0x000001dc bit2 en_spreadcycle=1, bit3 shaft=1, bit4 index_otpw=1, bit6 pdn_disable=1, bit7 mstep_reg_select=1, bit8 multistep_filt=1; I_scale_analog=0, internal_Rsense=0, index_step=0, en_pwm_mode(spread)=on IHOLD_IRUN 0x10 0x000a0900 (literal 0x08011c54) IHOLD=0, IRUN=9, IHOLDDELAY=10 TPOWERDOWN 0x11 0x80 128 CHOPCONF 0x6c 0x150082c3 (0x08011c58) TOFF=3, HSTRT=4, HEND=5 (raw), TBL=1, vsense=0, MRES=5 (8 usteps), intpol=1, dedge/diss2g/diss2vs=0 PWMCONF 0x70 0xc80d174b (0x08011c5c) pwm_ofs=75, pwm_grad=23, pwm_freq=1, autoscale=1, autograd=1, freewheel=0, pwm_reg=8, pwm_lim=12 (unused: spreadCycle)

NOT written by stock (chip power-on defaults): TPWMTHRS, TCOOLTHRS, SGTHRS, COOLCONF, any other register. No FACTORY_CONF/OTP writes found.

When written: once at boot (FUN_080111a0 -> FUN_08011bc8 x2); on debug F43 (re-init both); and in FUN_08017ad4 when flag 0x20000260 is set. That flag is set by the UART reply parser (FUN_080126d0 @0x080126d0 for USART2, the twin parser at 0x080128a8 for UART7) when a GCONF read reply has low byte != 0xdc (driver reset / lost config): it runs the F112 stop (both EN high) then re-inits both drivers. F13 reads GCONF of both drivers each poll, so this is the only driver "health" check. NOT re-written per move or per channel. F42 S<1|2> I writes IHOLD_IRUN live = (n<<8)|0xa0000 (n clamped 31; IHOLD stays 0); debug only.

items.title: 2. Enable (EN) behaviour (stock)
items.text:
GPIO helpers: FUN_08011984 = reg +0x10 (set pin high), FUN_08011980 = reg +0x14 (pin low). EN active low.

Selector (PB1), state machine FUN_0801900c: - PB1 low (enabled) on every tick of a move state (homing states 1-3, move states 7/0xc/0x12/0x17/0x1d/0x22/..., manual 0x81). - PB1 high (off) on arrival of every move (states 4, 7, 0xc, 0x12, ... "== target" branch) and at init and in error state 0x7e. So selector is energized only while stepping; parked = off. - F24 (select chan): state 1 -> home (PB1 low) -> state 4 (PB1 high) -> move to slot -> PB1 high on arrival. F23: only clears a bit in a mask (no motion). F39 (release): state 0xc, moves to neutral 2048 then PB1 high.

Feed (PA5), via enable mask bytes 0x20000436 (requested) / 0x20000437 (applied), FUN_0801874c / FUN_080186a0: - Bit set -> PA5 low (enabled). Set when a planned block has steps on the axis (FUN_08016540 -> FUN_08018678). - F10 (feed, states 10/0x15/0x20/0x2b -> 0xb/0x16/0x21/..) runs the move, waits for the queue to empty (FUN_08016374==0), goes to state 5 (ready). It does NOT release EN. PA5 stays low until F112 or an F11 finishing. Whether firmwareExe sends F112 after every F10 is host side, not in this binary (the host does after the toolhead sensor trips). - F11 (unload, states 0xe/0x19/0x24/0x2f): ends in state 0x10/0x1b/.. = FUN_08015d28 = planner stop + PA5 high + PB1 high. So F11 always releases the feed at the end. - F112 (FUN_08015d28): PA5 high and PB1 high, state 5. Also called on GCONF mismatch. - No idle timeout, no timer-based disable found anywhere. Stall/over-temp never stops the motors (F14/F40 only report). - Standstill current: IHOLD=0 with IHOLDDELAY=10 and TPOWERDOWN=128 (~2.8 s at standstill, then ramp down). Per TMC2209 scale (CS+1)/32 that is 1/32 of full scale = about 0.014 A rms if the 0.5 ohm resistors are the sense resistors. Freewheel field = 0. How the MS35776 clone treats IHOLD=0: NOT verified (the idle feed does brake a strand, so it is not zero current). - Motors are therefore left energized at standstill in stock only on the feed after F10 until F112, at IHOLD 0.

items.title: 3. Feed motion profile (stock)
items.text:
• Planner is Marlin-like trapezoid (FUN_08016540, FUN_080158d0, FUN_08015768). Timer TIM5 (0x40000c00): 144 MHz/36 = 4 MHz, period 2000 = 2 kHz tick. Step accumulator uses 2,000,000/rate (FUN_080158b4).
  • Feed = axis 0. steps/mm = 343696245/1e6 = 343.696 (8 usteps). Max speed table 0x20000340 = {30000,30000,600,3200,3200} mm/min -> axis 0 = 500 mm/s (effectively no limit; host S is the speed). Accel table 0x20000440 = {700,350,600,100000,100000}; axis 0 = 700 (mm/s^2 by the x steps/mm scaling, inferred). Entry/exit step-rate floor 0x78 = 120 steps/s (0.35 mm/s).
  • Host speeds seen: feed S1200 mm/min = 20 mm/s, unload S600 (10 mm/s), SILK/special 200-300 (3-5 mm/s).
  • Selector: TIM6 144 MHz/72/156 = 12820 Hz, STEP toggled each tick = 6410 usteps/s = 140.86 deg/s constant, no ramp.
  • Unresolved: the block step counts for axis 0 are mixed CoreXY style (A=x+y, B=x-y, both pins identical PA0), so whether stock emits 1 or 2 pulses per step on PA0 is not proven; the 640 mm lane measurement agrees with 343.7 steps/mm in Kalico, so treat as 1.

items.title: 4. Thermal / current protection (stock)
items.text:
• None active. DRV_STATUS (reg 0x6f) is read only by debug F44 (and F40-F64 dumps), never evaluated. No OTPW/OT check, no duty limit, no timeout.
  • F14/F40 stall = Silk speed-sensor movement detection (ADC), reported only; no stop.
  • Only auto-reaction: GCONF != 0xdc low byte -> stop + re-init.
  • Real protection in stock is duty: short moves, EN released at end of F11/F112, IRUN 9 only.

items.title: 5. Stock vs ours
items.text:
Ours = AFC_Hardware-IFS.cfg + kalico-ad5x tmc2209 defaults. Nominal current = (CS+1)/32 x Vfs / (sqrt2 x (Rsense+0.02)); Vfs 0.32 (vsense0) / 0.18 (vsense1) as Kalico computes, Rsense 0.5 (unverified).

Item Stock Ours Verdict / heat impact GCONF 0x1dc 0x1dc (driver_SHAFT: 1, driver_INDEX_OTPW: 1) MATCH en_spreadcycle 1 1 (no stealthchop_threshold) MATCH I_scale_analog / pdn_disable 0 / 1 0 / 1 MATCH IRUN steady state 9, vsense 0 = 0.138 A 9, vsense 0 (driver_IRUN: 9, driver_VSENSE: 0) MATCH IRUN at startup 9 9, vsense 0 (set directly, no startup macro) MATCH IHOLD 0 hold_current 0.01 -> ihold 0 (vsense1 and 0) MATCH IHOLDDELAY 10 10 MATCH TPOWERDOWN 128 128 MATCH CHOPCONF TOFF/HSTRT/HEND/TBL 3/4/5/1 3/4/5/1 MATCH CHOPCONF vsense 0 0 MATCH MRES / intpol 8 usteps / 1 microsteps 8 / interpolate True MATCH PWMCONF ofs75 grad23 freq1 as ag1 fw0 reg8 lim12 ofs75 grad23 (driver_PWM_OFS, driver_PWM_GRAD), rest same MATCH TPWMTHRS not written (0) 0 (driver_TPWMTHRS: 0) MATCH TCOOLTHRS/SGTHRS/COOLCONF not written (0) SGTHRS 0, COOLCONF 0 MATCH Re-write per move never not re-written unless AFC sets print_current (not set) MATCH Feed EN lifetime on during F10 move; stays on until F112/F11 end; host sends F112 AFC do_enable; in earlier config AFC sync_to_extruder kept the drive enabled and stepping for the whole print (patched 2026-10-25 to disable instead) UNKNOWN for current AFC lane.move end (AFC source not local). Biggest heat suspect: continuous IRUN for hours when synced Selector EN only while stepping AFC select_lane(disable_selector) / return_to_home disable UNKNOWN per call path; 5 s left-on test showed no problem Idle disable none in stock; EN released by F11/F112 no idle disable in our cfg UNKNOWN (Kalico idle_timeout behaviour on AFC steppers not checked) Feed speed S1200 = 20 mm/s, S600 = 10 mm/s 20 mm/s long/short MATCH Feed accel 700 (inferred) 500 (long_moves_accel, short_moves_accel; 500 per STOCK_FEED_ACCEL.md) see STOCK_FEED_ACCEL.md Steps/mm 343.696 1600/4.655 = 343.72 MATCH Selector speed / ramp 140.86 deg/s, none 70.43 deg/s, accel 0 (selector_movement_speed, selector_movement_accel) stock speed not settled: 140.86 here, 70.43 in stock-firmware.md (timer clock unproven, STOCK_FEED_ACCEL.md)

items.title: Likely overheat causes, in order
items.text:
1. Drive left enabled and stepping (sync_to_extruder) during a print at IRUN while the clamped filament holds the lane: stock never energizes the feed while printing.
  2. Before ifs_stock_current existed (or whenever it did not run), the feed ran at vsense1/CS31 = 0.245 A nominal, 1.8x stock current.
  3. Feed commanded against a jam or after F10 with no F112 equivalent, so IRUN/IHOLD-delay current at a blocked motor.

Not verified: that the R500 parts are the sense resistors (current figures scale with them), 35BYJ46 winding resistance, clone IHOLD=0 behaviour.

items.title: Stock AD5X host (firmwareExe) filament handling: spec to match
items.text:
Source: static analysis (Ghidra 12.2). Binary: firmwareExe from software 3.1.6, md5 53002874d76d1b381e45d4b533884408 (md5 read from the Ghidra program itself), MIPS32, not stripped. Addresses are function entry points (SerialObject:: unless stated). The F112 analysis is in STOCK_HOST_RELEASE.md and is not repeated; firmwareExe: filament change has the printer config values and the AFC mapping.

Conventions used below - "G:" = G-code sent to Klipper through sendGcodeCmd (JSON-RPC gcode/script on the Klipper API socket). The 4th argument 1 means wait for the reply (Klipper replies when the command is queued, not when the move is done, hence the many M400). Only cutFilament's G1 E-60 and the SAVE_GCODE_STATE in the pause path are sent with wait = 0. - "IFS:" = text command to the IFS over ttyS4 via sendCmdToUart4 (mutex, tcflush, write "<cmd> \r\n", usleep(100000), then select with 2 s timeout for the reply; Serial::sendToUart4WaitRecv 005dc760). Only F13 and F19 are sent when the IFS is flagged absent (this+0x2e2 == 0); everything else returns "" without sending. - Reply parse everywhere: split on [: ], field 3 = state: 5 = move done/idle, 0x7f = error (homing/driver), 0x7e = busy/timeout. Some functions also read fields 5 and 11 of the same reply (checkPurgeOldFilament). F-code meanings: F10 feed, F11 exit/retract, F12 sensors, F13 status, F15 re-home, F23/F24 channel select, F39 release, F112 stop. - Lnnn Snnn on F10/F11: L = length mm, S = speed (same units as G1 F, mm/min). - "toolhead sensor" = checkFilamentSenser 005f1af4: sends G GET_FILAMENT_VALUE, parses value:<float>; filament present iff value <= 0.3 || value >= 0.72. (Stock query_adc.py: eboard PA3 ADC, object temperature_sensor filamentValue; the second ADC cutValue PA2 is the cutter sensor, reported as query_adc.cut.) - Cancel flag = this+0x2e3; pause flag = this+0x8a; "polling-busy" flag this+0x2f0 (set 1 inside feed/load/cut waits so the status thread recvQueryFourInOneSt stays quiet). - Config values are in /usr/data/config/Adventurer5M.json (leftExtruderOffset.{xOffset,yOffset,zOffset,CutXOffset,CutYOffset}, Multicolour.*, FFMInfo.channel); getter defaults in the binary: xOffset 0, yOffset 0, CutXOffset 0, CutYOffset 0, channel 1, UnloadESpace 60, UnloadIFSSpace 70, UnloadSpeed 600 (those three are only read by initMulticolourConfig and UI time estimators, not used as command lengths). Values on the test printer: xOffset 0, yOffset 1.5, CutXOffset 1.7, CutYOffset 1.9. - Below, px = xOffset, py = yOffset (these are what Config::getLeftExtruderXOffset/YOffset return and what is passed as the x/y arguments of every purge/brush/clear function).

items.title: 1. Klipper side that triggers a toolchange (stock virtual_sdcard.py, software-3.1.6)
items.text: Not part of the host binary, but it is the trigger. - Host sends once at print start: SDCARD_SET_CHANNEL CHANNEL=<first chn> (sets load_channel and print_channel) and SDCARD_ENABLE_FFM ENABLE=1 only if (IFS present this+0x2e2 && multicolour job && this+0x290 >= 2), else ENABLE=0. - While printing from the file, a line that is exactly T0..T15 and enable_ffm is consumed, not executed: print_channel = n; if n != load_channel: run M400, set change_filament = True and poll every 0.5 s until the host sends SDCARD_CLEAR_REFUELLING (or the print is paused/cancelled); then load_channel = print_channel, continue with the next line. - Host polls objects/query (list in sendGcodeCmd case 3): virtual_sdcard[is_active, progress, file_position, file_size, channel, refuelling], pause_resume.is_paused, fan_generic fanM106/chamber_fan/external_fan/internal_fan.speed, print_stats[filename, filament_used, state], toolhead.homed_axes, gcode_move[gcode_position, absolute_extrude, speed], webhooks.state, extruder[temperature,target], heater_bed[temperature,target], query_adc[value,cut], exclude_object.clear_mem. doQueryResponse stores refuelling in the m_refulling field (this+0x2e0, the only writer besides init/changeChannel) and channel in m_channel. No temperature command is issued by the T line: the nozzle target for the new filament is whatever the sliced G-code set before Tn (see 5.3).

items.title: 2. Per-filament-type tables (type string from FFMInfo for the channel, getChnFilamentType; default "PLA" if empty)
items.text:
Compared by exact string: PLA, PETG, TPU, SILK, PLA-CF, PETG-CF, PC-ABS. Any other string (including ABS, PLA-CF, PETG-CF where not listed) takes the "other" column.

function (addr) PLA PETG TPU SILK PLA-CF / PETG-CF / other getFilamentTypeFristSpeed(chn,false) 005e3c68 = feed F of first flush G1 E90 300 300 100 150 300 getFilamentTypeFristSpeed(chn,true) = fan S (0-255) during first flush 0 51 51 51 0 getFilamentTypeSecondSpeed(chn,false) 005e3f44 = feed F of second flush 300 300 100 150 300 getFilamentTypeSecondSpeed(chn,true) = fan S after flush 125 102 102 102 125 getFilamentTypeUnloadSpeed 005e4070 (F11 S and G1 E-60 F) 600 300 200 300 600 getFilamentTypeUnloadSpace 005e41b0 60 60 60 60 60 getFilamentTypeTemp 005e459c (end-of-print purge only) 220 250 230 230 220 (PETG-CF 250, PC-ABS 250) getFilamentTypeTime 005e3db8 (s, checkPurgeOldFilament wait) 15 15 36 36 15 getFilamentTypeLoadFristSpace 005e42e4 80 70 80 80 80 getFilamentTypeLoadSpace 005e445c 60 50 50 60 60 (PETG-CF 40)

Notes: the string at 0x00adcde8 is PETG, at 0x00adcdf0 is TPU. FristSpeed and SecondSpeed take (chn, bool): bool true returns the fan value, false the feed rate.

items.title: 3.1 printClearGoPos(x=px, y=py) 005ed008 (park at purge chute)
items.text: G: G1 X<px+52.5> F12000, G1 Y220 F12000, G1 Y<py+229> F3000, M400. Numbers formatted 'f', 2 decimals (QString::number(v,'f',2)). Constants: double 52.5 at 0x00ae04f0, float 229.0 at 0x00ae04f8. With px 0, py 1.5: X52.50 then Y220 then Y230.50. X is moved first at whatever Y the head is at.

items.title: 3.2 fourInOneCut(chn, x, y) 005f5860 (cutter)
items.text: G, in order: M400, G90, G1 Y10 F18000, G1 Y<CutYOffset-7.5> F1800, G1 X20 F12000 (two spaces in the literal), G1 X<CutXOffset-2.5> F600, M400, G92 E0, G1 E-5 F600, M400, then printClearGoPos(x,y), then IFS checkCrotchCutting(chn) (3.3), then M400. (Constants: doubles 7.5 at 0x00ae04e0 and 2.5 at 0x00ae04e8. With CutY 1.9, CutX 1.7: Y-5.60, X-0.80.) The cutter lever is pushed by the X move at F600; there is no second cut or dwell.

items.title: 3.3 checkCrotchCutting(chn) 005f4f8c (select/clamp lane)
items.text: IFS F24 C<chn>; set busy flag; loop: IFS F13, parse state; exit when state == 5, or after 21 polls (counter > 0x14), or on cancel; on 0x7f: send F15, then F24 C<chn> again, counter reset to 1; state 0x7e: leave the loop. sleep(1) between polls (about 21 s worst case). No error is raised here.

items.title: 3.4 checkCrotchF39(chn) 005f8da0 (release)
items.text: IFS F39 C<chn>, then the same poll shape as 3.3 (F13, 1 s, up to about 11 polls, 0x7f -> F15 and resend F39 C<chn>).

items.title: 3.5 cutFilament(chn, x, y) 005f5e58
items.text: fourInOneCut(chn,x,y); G G92 E0; IFS F11 C<chn> L60 S<UnloadSpeed(type)> (sent first); G G1 E-60 F<UnloadSpeed> (UnloadSpace = 60, sent without waiting, so the lane retract and the extruder retract overlap). Returns 0. The L60 is a literal, not a config value.

items.title: 3.6 checkRefullingFrist(chn) 005f2478 / checkRefulling(chn) 005f1d84 (wait for old filament to leave the toolhead)
items.text: Poll IFS F13 every 1 s (sleep(1)); checkRefullingFrist: when the toolhead sensor reads empty, IFS F112 (resent if the reply lacks "ok") + M400, return 0. Returns: 1 cancel, 4 if state 5 persists for more than 10 polls while the sensor still reads filament, 8 on state 0x7f, 10 after 11 polls of 0x7e. checkRefulling is the same poll without the F112 and is used for the second pass.

items.title: 3.7 fourInOneUnLoad(chn, flag) 005f616c (lane retract until toolhead clear)
items.text: Polls IFS F13 (usleep-based, 200 ms); every time the IFS is idle (state 5) and the toolhead sensor still shows filament it re-clamps (checkCrotchCutting, F24) and sends F11 C<chn> L70 S600; three times with L70, then a last one F11 C<chn> L60 S600 (literals " L70 S" x3 and " L60 S", S = 0x258 = 600). On 0x7f: F15, checkCrotchCutting, resend. Ends when the sensor reads empty or on timeout ("Unload timeOut!").

items.title: 3.8 checkFeeding(chn) 005f9674 (wait for toolhead sensor after a long feed)
items.text: Busy flag set. Loop with usleep(100000) per turn: IFS F13, state: - 5 and pause flag (+0x8a): IFS F112, return 7. - 5 after the retry phase and not yet re-fed: checkCrotchCutting(chn) then IFS F10 C<chn> L500 S1200, once. - 0x7f: return 8 (caller sends F15). 0x7e more than 100 times: return 10 ("IFS home error"). - toolhead sensor reads filament: IFS F112, return 0. - cancel flag: IFS F112, return 1. - 301 turns (about 30 s) without sensor: first time send IFS F11 C<chn> L5 S1200 (back off 5 mm) and enter retry phase, counter 0; second time (another 30 s): sigIFSError(E0100+chn-1) (see 6), checkCrotchF39(chn), return 3. Returns 0 and 7 are success.

items.title: 3.9 checkLoad(chn, S) 005fbaa0 (flush-time feed wait)
items.text: Used by the first flush. Poll IFS F13 every 1 s. State 5: if toolhead sensor reads filament send F112 and return 0; state 5 with sensor empty: continue counting. 0x7f: F15, checkCrotchCutting(chn), IFS F10 C<chn> L30 S<S>, sleep 1, return code 8 path (restart loop). 0x7e more than 10: return 10. After 6 polls: once checkCrotchF39(chn). After 31 polls: first time checkCrotchCutting(chn) + IFS F10 C<chn> L50 S<S> and counters reset; second time sigIFSError(E0100+chn-1); loop-top retry after timeOutPause() resends F10 C<chn> L600 S<S>. S is the speed given by flushFilamentFrist.

items.title: 3.10 Flush pieces
items.text:
flushFilamentFrist(chn) 005fc930 (type = type of channel Config::getChannel, i.e. the channel just set; chn argument is the lane to feed): 1. G M106 S<FristSpeed(true)> 2. G G92 E0 3. G G1 E90 F<FristSpeed(false)> 4. IFS F10 C<chn> L90 S<FristSpeed(false)> (lane pushes in step with the extruder) 5. checkLoad(chn, FristSpeed(false)) (3.9). If it returns 1 (cancel) stop. Else checkCrotchF39(chn), G M400, G M106 S<SecondSpeed(true)>.

flushFilamentSecond(chn) 005ee3ec: 1. G M106 S<FristSpeed(true)>; sleep(1) three times (3 s, aborted by cancel) 2. G G92 E0; G G1 E90 F<SecondSpeed(false)>; G M400 3. G M106 S<SecondSpeed(true)>

flushFilamentBrush(second, x=px, y=py) 005ee7dc: 1. sleep(1) x3 (3 s, ooze cool-down, abort on cancel) 2. if second == true: G G92 E0, G1 E-3 F300, M400, G92 E0 3. G G1 Y220 F12000, G1 Y<py+229> F3000, G1 Y220 F12000, G1 Y<py+229> F3000, G1 Y220 F12000 4. if second == false: G G1 X<px+52.5> F12000, G1 Y<py+229> F3000 5. G M400

cleanFilamentBox(newChn, flushVol, x=px, y=py) 005fce9c (one purge pass): G G1 X<px+52.5> F12000, G1 Y<py+229> F3000, M400; flushFilamentFrist(newChn); flushFilamentBrush(false); flushFilamentSecond(newChn); flushFilamentBrush(true); IFS F23 C<newChn>. The flushVol argument is not used inside (see 4). Extruder amount per pass: 90 + 90 = 180 mm; first 90 mm have the lane pushing 90 mm (L90).

clearCurrentChnFilament(chn,x,y) 005eeedc: printClearGoPos, flushFilamentSecond(chn), flushFilamentBrush(false).

clearAllFilament(x,y) 005f3e14: up to 8 times: clearCurrentChnFilament; stop when the toolhead sensor reads empty, then G G1 Y220 F12000, M400, return 0; between tries sleep(1); after 8 tries clearOldFilament and return 1. Cancel/pause returns 1.

clear_brush(y) 005ed4d0 (X brush, used at resume and at leveling, not in toolchange): G G1 Y220 F3000, G1 X78 F12000, G1 Y<y+229> F3000, G1 X65 F12000, G1 X73, G1 X65, G1 X73, G1 X65, G1 X78, G1 Y220, M400. clearBrush(y) 005ed968 is identical without the final G1 Y220.

checkPurgeOldFilament(chnIdx, x, y) 005f454c (print start, filament already at the toolhead): if toolhead sensor reads empty return; else G M106 S<FristSpeed(true)>, G92 E0, G1 E90 F<FristSpeed(false)>; poll IFS F13 every 1 s up to getFilamentTypeTime s (fields 5 and 11 of the reply are checked for "idle" for more than that many consecutive polls); G M400, M106 S<SecondSpeed(true)>; flushFilamentBrush(false); if the lane still reads loaded: up to 8 times clearCurrentChnFilament until the toolhead sensor reads empty (sleep 1); G M400, G92 E0.

items.title: 4. Flush volume
items.text:
getFlushVol(oldChn, newChn) 005f2cd4 = calc_flush_vol(...) 005cc724 on the lane colour strings (FFMInfo colour 1..4, parsed with QColor::setNamedColor). Result is integer, clamped 60..800.

Algorithm (constants from the data section): colours as r,g,b/255; HSV via RGB2HSV; for old colour (src) and new colour (dst): - lum = 0.3*r + 0.59*g + 0.11*b - dxy = hypot( cos(h1)*s1*v1 - cos(h2)*s2*v2 , sin(h1)*s1*v1 - sin(h2)*s2*v2 ) with h in degrees converted by /180*pi; dhs = min(dxy, 1.2) - if lum_dst >= lum_src: lumi = (lum_dst - lum_src)^0.7 * 560 - else: lumi = (lum_src - lum_dst) * 80 and dhs = min(dhs, 0.67*v_dst + 0.33*v_src) - hs = dhs * 230 - vol = sqrt(hs^2 + lumi^2 + hs*lumi) (law of cosines, cos = -0.5); if vol < 60 -> 60; else (int)vol, max 800. This is the same shape as the OrcaSlicer/BambuStudio flush-volume formula.

Call-site quirk (as compiled): getFlushVol calls calc_flush_vol(R1,G1,B1,0xff, R2,G2,B2,0xff) but the function reads its first parameter as alpha and parameters 2..4 as R,G,B. Effective inputs: if R1 == 0 the src colour is treated as transparent (white); otherwise src colour = (G1, B1, 255)/255. Same for dst with R2. So red is only used as an on/off flag and blue is always 255. Reproduce this only if exact stock numbers are wanted.

Use of the result (changeChannel 005fe970): only to choose the number of purge passes: passes = 1 + (vol > 400); each pass is one cleanFilamentBox, followed by M400. The extruder amount per pass is constant 180 mm. No matrix, no per-pass E scaling. Config has no flush multiplier. Colour mapping: getFlushVol(oldChn = Config::getChannel() before the change, newChn).

items.title: 5.1 First load / auto-insert (idle, spool inserted)
items.text:
Trigger: recvQueryFourInOneSt 005fa660 sees a lane sensor bit rise (mask this+0x298) while not printing -> checkFourInOneLoad(newMask, enabledMask) 005fa288, lanes 1..4: 1. sigAutoLoad(chn) (UI dialog "auto load") 2. fourInOneLoadFristStep(chn) 005f839c: toolhead sensor read once at the start and kept (local_44); it never aborts on it (the function returns only 0, 1 or 10). checkCrotchCutting(chn) (F24); IFS F10 C<chn> L650 S1200 (0x28a, 0x4b0); poll IFS F13 every 100 ms (usleep(100000)), up to 0x78 = 120 polls, stop when the toolhead sensor reads filament only if it read empty at the start; if it already read filament at the start the sensor is ignored and the feed runs to the poll limit or the end of the move; 0x7e more than 10 -> return 10; 0x7f: F15, checkCrotchCutting, resend F10 C<chn> L650 S1200; on stop: IFS F112. 3. fourInOneLoadSecondStep(chn) 005f7b4c: IFS F11 C<chn> L100 S1200; poll F13 every 200 ms until state 5; 0x7f: F15, checkCrotchCutting, resend F11 ... L100 S1200. 4. IFS F23 C<chn>; checkCrotchF39(chn) (F39 C<chn>). Return 10 -> dialog E0114: IFS ... home error! and sigIFSError(.., E0114). No heating, no flush and no G-code in this path; extruder is not moved. Lane parks 100 mm back from the sensor trip point.

Pause-time insert (checkPauseAutoLoad 005fade4, from ifsPaused): clearAllFilament(px,py), checkCrotchCutting(chn), IFS F10 C<chn> L200 S1200, poll F13 1 s, IFS F23 C<chn>, checkCrotchF39(chn).

items.title: 5.2 Load at print start (serialPrint 006042e4, normal start, IFS present, multicolour)
items.text: Before serialPrint: the Print screen has set bed target (setPlatformHeat -> G M140 S<t>) and, once the bed has arrived (waitArriveTemperature(false,false,true)), setRightNozzleTemp -> G M104 S<job nozzle temp> (job temp from the G-code header scan in Print::initWidget: strings M104, M109, M140, M141, M190, T0; chamber target > 0 delays the nozzle). setRightNozzleTemp sends M104 S0 T0 instead if the nozzle sensor reads below -10 (float at 0x00aeae3c), otherwise M104 S<t>; bed likewise M140 S0 / M140 S<t>. The per-type temperature table (section 2) is NOT used here. serialPrint start, in order: 1. G G92 E0 2. G CLEAR_PAUSE; G SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=pcb_fan SPEED=1 3. Non-IFS or non-multicolour print: G G1 Z10 F500, G92 E0, flushFilamentSecond(chn-1), flushFilamentBrush(true,px,py), M106 S0. (Then straight to step 6.) 4. IFS print: checkPurgeOldFilament(chn-1, px, py); checkPrintUnLoad(laneMask, currentLoadedChn, px, py) 005f6e58: toolhead empty -> proceed; else once cutFilament(cur), then fourInOneUnLoad(cur,false) if its lane bit is set, else try fourInOneUnLoad(lane,true) on the other lanes with filament; if the toolhead still reads filament after all four: IFS F23 C<cur> and sig_extruderSensorAbort (E0113), return 0. 5. changeChannel(mode=1, firstChn, px, py) (5.3 without the Z lift/return): doLoadAndUnload(new=first, old=Config::getChannel, flag=1), wait for nozzle, getFlushVol, Config::setChannel(first), cleanFilamentBox x passes, then SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=fanM106 SPEED=<this+0x228>, M400, SDCARD_CLEAR_REFUELLING. Then operationFilament(chn,4,0,chn) (UI state). 6. G M21; G M23 <path under /usr/data/gcodes>; G M26 S<seek>; G SDCARD_SET_CHANNEL CHANNEL=<n>; G SDCARD_ENABLE_FFM ENABLE=0|1; G M24. EXCLUDE_OBJECT NAME=<n> lines are sent for excluded objects between M26 and M24. Prime/first layer: the host sends no prime line or first-layer move; it is all in the sliced file. (Print::doPreparation/checkZ is the leveling prep: BED_MESH_CLEAR, G1 Z50 F3000, M106 P0 S255, G1 X60 Y-3 F12000, G1 X130 F1200, G1 X150 F1200, G1 Z5 F600/F800/F6000, BED_MESH_PROFILE LOAD|REMOVE=...; not part of a normal print start.)

items.title: 5.3 Toolchange during print (changeChannel(mode=0, newChn, px, py) 005fe970)
items.text: Trigger: refuelling (+0x2e0) true while IFS multicolour print is running (serialPrint main loop, 50 ms usleep poll). If the previous state flag local_a0 == 1 (a runout was already detected) clearAllFilament(px,py) runs first (result 1 -> pause flag set, state 2). Else call straight in: 1. G M400; save state (this+0x134=1, +0x140, +0x138=newChn; power-loss file written via PowerSavingModeFile::setPowerSavingMode). 2. G M114; parse X: and Y: (saved); saved Z is this+0x2ec (from gcode_position). 3. Z lift (mode 0 only): z' = (z > 220) ? 220 : z + 5 (doubles 220.0 at 0x00aeae60, 5.0 at 0x00aeae68). G G1 Z<z'> F800, G M400. 4. doLoadAndUnload(new, old = Config::getChannel(), px, py, flag=0) 005fda70 (5.4). Returns: 1 cancelled (return 1 from changeChannel); 6 no filament available (changeChannel returns 6 -> caller sets the pause flag, state 2); 9 lane substituted by autodetect (new = lane found); else continue. 5. Wait for nozzle temperature: loop sleep(1) until nozzle real >= nozzle target and target > 0 (integer compare, no tolerance, no timeout), or until the pause flag is set. The target is whatever the file/slicer already set before Tn; the host does not choose a temperature here (no M104/M109 in changeChannel, doLoadAndUnload, cleanFilamentBox, flushFilament*). Rule between old and new type: not applied by the host. (Searched all callers: getFilamentTypeTemp is called only from the end-of-print cleanup, 5.7.) 6. fanSave = this+0x224 -> this+0x228. getFlushVol(old, new) (section 4). Config::setChannel(new). 7. passes = 1 + (vol > 400) x { cleanFilamentBox(new, vol, px, py) (3.10); G M400 }. 8. UI update (printChnFilament); this+0xd0 = 1 (mode 0); clear change flag; power-loss state saved. 9. G SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=fanM106 SPEED=<this+0x228> 10. mode 0 only: G G1 Y<savedY> F12000, M400, G1 X<savedX> F12000, M400, G1 Z<savedZ> F800, M400, then G92 E<this+0xbc> if this+0xbc >= 0 else G92 E0. 11. G M400; this+0x2e0 = 0; G SDCARD_CLEAR_REFUELLING (releases Klipper).

items.title: 5.4 doLoadAndUnload(newChn, oldChn, x, y, flag) 005fda70
items.text: Start: if the toolhead sensor reads filament and loaded-chn (this+0x24c) != newChn, or flag == 0: cutFilament(oldChn,x,y) (3.5) and treat as needing unload; else (flag 1, nothing to unload) checkCrotchCutting(newChn). Loop until done/cancel (each iteration ends sleep(1)): - Unload phase (while unload pending): - checkRefullingFrist(oldChn) (3.6): result 8 -> IFS F15, checkCrotchCutting(old), IFS F11 C<old> L50 S1200, sleep 1, repeat; 4 -> if a second cut was already done: sigIFSError(E0104+old-1) (getIFSUnLoadErrorCode) + checkCrotchF39(old) + pause; else cutFilament(old) again, sleep 1; 10 -> dialog E0114 (IFS home error, channel number appended), sleep, pause path; 1 -> return 1; 0 -> IFS F11 C<old> L70 S1200 (first time), sleep 1, then second pass with checkRefulling(old) (same codes, resend uses checkCrotchCutting instead). - Load phase: read the lane mask (this+0x298); if the new lane bit is clear: count 1 s ticks; after 11 ticks autoDetectLoad(new, ...) (finds another lane with the same type string and same colour string among lanes with filament, sets the slot->lane map this+(slot+0x94)*4, and unless suppressed runs doAutoDetectLoad); if none: autoLoadNoFilamentPause (UI), G M25, pause flag, return 6. If the lane has filament: IFS F10 C<new> L1000 S1200 (0x4b0), checkFeeding(new) (3.8): - 0 or 7 -> done (9 if lane was substituted); - 8 -> IFS F15, checkCrotchCutting(old/param), sleep 1, retry; - 3 or 10 -> timeOutPause() (user pause dialog), on resume re-select lane and retry; - 1 -> cancel. - On success G M400 and return. doAutoDetectLoad(chn) 005fd288: checkCrotchCutting(chn), IFS F10 C<chn> L1000 S1200, checkFeeding(chn) (3 -> fail), Config::setChannel(chn), cleanFilamentBox(chn, 0, px, py).

items.title: 5.5 Runout (lane empty while printing, serialPrint main loop)
items.text: Each 50 ms tick: if the current slot's lane bit in this+0x298 is clear: counter++; at 20 ticks (about 1 s): if the toolhead sensor still reads filament, compute filament_used - baseline; while that is <= 600 mm (float at 0x00aeae40) set state 1 and keep printing (the filament left in the tube is used up); else (toolhead empty or more than 600 mm extruded): G SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PAUSE_state (no wait), G M25, wait for pause, G G1 Z<min(z+5,220)> F800, clearCurrentChnFilament, autoDetectLoad(...) for a lane with the same type+colour; success: G RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PAUSE_state MOVE=1 MOVE_SPEED=100, M400, resume; failure: state 2 and the normal pause path (5.6) with autoLoadNoFilamentPause dialog.

items.title: 5.6 Pause / resume / cancel
items.text: Pause (pause flag +0x8a, user or runout, serialPrint): 1. printPause(); G M25; G SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PAUSE_state (no wait) (skipped if state 2). 2. save Z (this+0xb8), G SET_IDLE_TIMEOUT TIMEOUT=864000; save nozzle and bed targets (+0x15c, +0x160), fan +0x228 = +0x224. 3. wait until the Klipper pause_resume.is_paused state arrives (6 polls then resend M25, max 31). 4. setRightNozzleTemp(0) (G M104 S0), G M106 S255, G G1 Z<min(z+5,220)> F800 (if z <= 220 add 5.0). 5. printClearGoPos(px,py); operationFilament(chn,6,0,chn); printPauseFinish; G SET_STEPPER_ENABLE STEPPER=extruder ENABLE=0; G M106 S0. 6. No IFS: wait (200 ms poll) until the pause flag clears. IFS: ifsPaused() 005fb334 (polls F13, lets the user insert a spool -> checkPauseAutoLoad). Resume: printResume(); resumePrintPreHeating (G M104 S<saved>, M140 S<saved>); sleep(3); wait waitArriveTemperature(false,true,true) (nozzle within -2..+5 of target, bed within -2..+5 of target; target < 30 nozzle / < 10 bed counts as arrived) with sleep(1); G SET_STEPPER_ENABLE STEPPER=extruder ENABLE=1; G SET_IDLE_TIMEOUT TIMEOUT=864000; printClearGoPos; flushFilamentSecond(slotChn); flushFilamentBrush(false); G SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=fanM106 SPEED=<saved>; G G90; clear_brush(py); printResumeFinish; if a toolchange was pending (+0x2e0): changeChannel(0, ...) first, else G RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=PAUSE_state MOVE=1 MOVE_SPEED=100, M400, M24, poll VS state until printing again (max 31 s, resend M24 after 6). timeOutPause() 005fb804 (used by feed/load timeouts): sigTimeOutPause (dialog), G SET_IDLE_TIMEOUT TIMEOUT=864000, pausePrintDo (G M104 S0, M106 S0), operationFilament(chn,6), printPauseFinish, extruder disable, ifsPaused(), then resume as above (sleep(3), wait temperature, operationFilament(chn,4), printResumeFinish, extruder enable). Cancel: UI/this+0x88: G CANCEL_PRINT; cancel flag +0x2e3 makes every wait above return early (F112 is sent by checkFeeding and checkLoad only in the listed branches); then the end-of-print cleanup (5.7) runs with printCancel().

items.title: 5.7 End of print (also after cancel)
items.text:
1. G M400; M114 read Z; park Z ladder: z<=50 -> 100, 50<z<=100 -> 150, 100<z<=150 -> 200, else 220 (doubles at 0x00aeaea8.. 0x00aeae90); G G1 Z<that> F800; G M400; powerSavingParamClear; printClearGoPos(px,py).
  2. If IFS and not error and state != 1: (a) current lane empty but toolhead reads filament: printCleanAllFilament, setRightNozzleTemp(getFilamentTypeTemp(chn)) (section 2: 220/230/250), then up to 7 times { wait nozzle arrived (waitArriveTemperature(false,true,false) 1 s poll), clearCurrentChnFilament, until toolhead reads empty }; (b) lane has filament and toolhead reads filament: cutFilament(chn) then fourInOneUnLoad(chn,false); then checkCrotchF39(chn). Then clearChnStatus() 005e3584 (IFS F23 C1..F23 C4) and operationFilament(0,0,0,0).
  3. G SET_IDLE_TIMEOUT TIMEOUT=1800, setRightNozzleTemp(0) (M104 S0), setPlatformHeat(0) (M140 S0), initPrinterFan, G M220 S100, M400, G92 E0, BED_MESH_CLEAR, BED_MESH_PROFILE REMOVE=default, CLEAR_PAUSE, SDCARD_RESET_FILE, SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=pcb_fan SPEED=0, SET_GCODE_OFFSET Z=0 MOVE=1, G90, M82, M18.
  4. Completed -> printCompleted(), cancelled -> printCancel(), error -> G CANCEL_PRINT + printHappendError().

items.title: 5.8 Power loss
items.text: State is written continuously through PowerSavingModeFile/PrintContinueConfig (fields: channel +0x138, change flag +0x134, +0x140, line number +0xe0, refuelling, clear, saved Z +0xb8, E +0xbc, targets, fan, file name). On recovery start (serialPrint recovery branch, strings "recovery first move x/y/z", "recovery speedCmd"): 1. If a change was in progress (+0x134): printClearGoPos; clearAllFilament; powerOffUnLoad(chn) 005f77f0 (F13 poll, fourInOneUnLoad on the lane(s) in use, cutFilament); changeChannel(1, savedNewChn, px, py). 2. Seek in the file (getRecoveryPrintSeek or seekNumOfRowsOfFile), G SET_IDLE_TIMEOUT TIMEOUT=864000, setPlatformHeat, setRightNozzleTemp (saved), G M106 S<fan*255> T0, wait waitArriveTemperature(false,true,true) (1 s poll), printClearGoPos, G G1 Z<savedZ+10> F800 (10.0 at 0x00aeae98), M400, flushFilamentSecond(chn), flushFilamentBrush(true), G G90, G1 Y220 F12000, G G92 E<savedE>, G1 E<savedE-1> F1000, G92 E<..>, M400, G G1 X<x> Y<y> F6000, G1 Z<z> F900, M400, G M220 S<speed>, G M106 S<fan*255> T0, G90/M82|M83 per absolute_extrude, M400, then the normal start tail (M21, M23, M26 S<seek>, SDCARD_SET_CHANNEL, SDCARD_ENABLE_FFM, M24).

items.title: 6. Error codes (UI dialog E<code>, https://wiki.flashforge.com/en/ad5x/error_code_list_ad5x#...)
items.text: code raised by text (wiki anchor) E0100..E0103 getIFSLoadErrorCode(chn) from checkFeeding (second 30 s timeout), checkLoad (second 31 s timeout) channel 1..4 feeding timeout E0104..E0107 getIFSUnLoadErrorCode(chn) from doLoadAndUnload (second cut did not clear the toolhead) channel 1..4 retracting timeout E0108 Filament::slot_operationError (UI load wizard) failed to feed filament to the extruder E0109 slotIFSMottorNoRunning 005f369c (IFS odometer roller N not moving; stall/vibr/silk counters, m_stallCount) IFS odometer roller 1/2/3/4 not moving E0110 only the wiki URL string found filament type mismatch (no raising code found) E0113 sig_extruderSensorAbort from checkPrintUnLoad and checkFourInOneLoad filament detected in the extruder, check feeding position, clean manually or check the sensor E0114 checkFourInOneLoad, doLoadAndUnload (state 0x7e more than 100 times / return 10), Filament::slot_ifsHomeError IFS homing error ("IFS home anomaly!" / "IFS home error!") E0116 / E0117 checkResponseError (Klipper messages Exception in priming_handler / Exception in flush_handler) exception in priming / flush E0001..E0011, E0017, E0118..E0123 checkResponseError (Klipper shutdown strings, TMC, MCU, heater, timer) not IFS related Shown to the user as E<code>: <text>; the "0x7e / 0x7f" values are internal IFS states and are never shown as such. "filament runout" has no dedicated E code: runout leads to the pause with the autoLoadNoFilamentPause dialog.

items.title: 7. Spool / colour / material data the host keeps (only what drives the above)
items.text:
• FFMInfo section of Adventurer5M.json: per channel 1..4 filament type string and colour string (accessors Config::getFilamentType1..4, getFilamentColor1..4; getChnFilamentType/Color(chn)), plus FFMInfo.channel (= Config::getChannel, the lane currently loaded, default 1, written by Config::setChannel after each successful change/auto-detect).
  • Slot -> lane map: this+(slot+0x94)*4 (array at this+0x250, slot = tool index in the file), current slot this+0x248, loaded lane this+0x24c, used-lane mask from the job this+0x294, lane-has-filament mask (IFS sensors, F-status) this+0x298, IFS present this+0x2e2.
  • Colour string drives only getFlushVol and autoDetectLoad (type and colour equality). Type string drives section 2 only. There is no spool weight or remaining-length data in these paths.

items.title: 8. Not found / uncertain
items.text:
• Exact S values of F10/F11 in places where the decompile hides the literal: all listed above come from the instruction-level literal dump (S1200 = 0x4b0 everywhere except the unload S600/S<UnloadSpeed> and flush S<FristSpeed>).
  • Semantics of IFS commands F15/F23/F39/F112 on the IFS side are from IFS motor spec and Stock IFS firmware, not re-derived here.
  • checkRefulling*/checkLoad poll thresholds (10/11/31/6) are read from slti constants; the exact branch that distinguishes the first vs second timeout in checkLoad was inferred from the flow (variable local_64), not single-stepped.
  • Nozzle temperature policy between old and new filament on a toolchange: not in the host (no M104/M109 on that path); it comes from the sliced G-code. Where the job nozzle temp Print+0xf0 is parsed from (Print::initWidget string scan) was not traced further.
  • Fan unit of this+0x224/0x228 (0..1 vs 0..255) not confirmed: resumePrintFanControl multiplies the stored float by 255 for M106 S, changeChannel writes it raw into SET_FAN_SPEED SPEED=, which takes 0..1.
  • getFilamentTypeLoadFristSpace / LoadSpace: no callers found.
  • No separate "tip forming", ramming or temperature-drop step exists in the host; the only filament shaping is the cutter, G1 E-5 F600 after the cut, then G1 E-60 with the lane retract.

items.title: Stock AD5X IFS firmware 3.0.7: behaviour spec
items.text:
Source: the stock ifs.bin (41168 B, base 0x08010000, N32G455): the Ghidra decompile (jump-table case bodies at 0x08012e3e decompiled and the whole app disassembled with literal pools resolved), its initial RAM image, Stock IFS firmware, Stock motor drive and Stock host release. Nothing was run on the printer. "not found" = looked for, absent. "inferred" = from code reading, not observed on hardware. Motor register init (TMC writes, EN, planner constants) is in STOCK_MOTOR_DRIVE.md and is not repeated.

Addresses FUN_xxxxxxxx are Ghidra names of the function entry. RAM addresses are 0x2000xxxx.

items.title: 0. Architecture
items.text: Item Value Main loop FUN_08015ea0 (called from Reset via thunk_FUN_08015ea0 0x080101a0). Runs forever: ADC sampling every 1001st pass, then FUN_08017ad4 (line parse + driver-reset handler) TIM6 ISR (vec_70 0x080124f8, 0x40001000, 144 MHz/72/156 = 12820 Hz) calls the FFS_state machine FUN_0801900c once per tick (78 us) TIM5 ISR (vec_66 0x080124d8, 0x40000c00, 2 kHz) feed planner tick FUN_0801813c SysTick (vec_15 0x080121b2 -> FUN_080121bc) reload = SystemCoreClock/50 - 1 (FUN_08015834): 50 Hz = 20 ms at 144 MHz. Speed-sensor movement latch (section 3.3) USART1 IDLE ISR (vec_53 0x08012824) host RX, DMA 200-byte buffer 0x20000ea4 USART2 IDLE ISR (vec_54 0x080128a8), UART7 IDLE ISR (vector 91, FUN_080126d0) TMC UART replies (feed = USART2, selector = UART7) DMA1 ch (vec_30 0x080111ec) USART1 TX complete: clears TX-busy 0x20000106, PA11 low (receive) Watchdog not found (no IWDG/WWDG address in the literal pools) FFS_state byte 0x200001b0, reset value 0 Selector position counter int 0x200001e0 (steps from home) Selector target slot 0x2000021b (0 = none/neutral, 1-4) Last channel (chan in F13) 0x200000f0, written by F10, F11, F23, F24, F39 (even for invalid values) Selector DIR flag 0x2000021a (1 = positive) Selector step phase 0x200001e4 (0/1) Driver-reset request / "needs ack" 0x20000260 / 0x20000098 Feed params F10: L 0x200000e4, S 0x200000ec (float, defaults 0 / 600.0). F11: L 0x200000e0 (stored negated), S 0x200000e8 (default 600.0, default L 0). F30: D 0x200000dc int (default 0x800)

items.title: 1.1 Link (host side /dev/ttyS4)
items.text:
• USART1 PA9/PA10, 115200, word length 8, 1 stop, no parity (FUN_080142b4: baud 0x1c200, other fields 0, mode 0x0c). RS485 direction PA11: high = transmit, low = receive (idle low).
  • Flashing (bootloader) uses 8E1 per Kalico firmware on the IFS, the app link is 8N1 here.

items.title: 1.2 Receive path (framing)
items.text:
1. vec_53 fires on USART IDLE (flag 0x424). It reads the DMA remaining count, n = 200 - remaining. If n < 3 the burst is discarded (buffer cleared, nothing queued). Otherwise each byte is pushed to the 200-byte ring buffer (0x20005de4, FUN_080149b0), the DMA buffer is cleared (FUN_08010202) and re-armed for 200 bytes.
  2. So a lone 0xFF (or any 1-2 byte burst, such as a bare \r\n) is dropped. There is no special 0xFF code anywhere; the host's 0xFF after the command is only dropped by this length rule (host side purpose, RS485 turnaround, inferred).
  3. A burst of 3+ bytes that contains 0xFF passes the 0xFF through as an ordinary character; it does no harm because the parser searches for F.
  4. Line assembler FUN_08015c54 (called every main pass), one char at a time from the ring:
  5. If a complete line is pending (flag 0x200000b9 = 1) it stops reading (one line buffered).
  6. Terminator '\n' or '\r', or buffer count > 0x5e (94).
  7. Terminator with count 0: ignored; clears the "comment" flag 0x200000c8.
  8. ';' sets the comment flag; characters after it are not stored. A line that had a ; is therefore NOT executed (flag stays set until an empty terminator clears it).
  9. Else the char is stored at 0x20000d1c[count++]. On terminator with count > 0: NUL-terminate, set 0x200000b9 = 1 (if not comment), count = 0.
  10. Main loop FUN_08017ad4: if 0x200000b9 set, call parser FUN_08012de8, clear the flag (parser always returns 1).

items.title: 1.3 Parser FUN_08012de8
items.text:
• strchr(line,'F') (first uppercase F anywhere; no F = line silently ignored, no reply). Number n = atof(p+1) truncated to int (FUN_08014908 = atof, FUN_08010564 = double->int).
  • Arguments: strchr(line, letter) for the FIRST occurrence of that uppercase letter anywhere in the line, atof of what follows. Letters: C channel (cast to byte), L length (float), S speed (float, mm/min; planner divides by 60.0 = 0x42700000), D (F30, int), T and I (F42). Case sensitive. Parameters are parsed (and stored) BEFORE the validity checks, so a rejected command still overwrites L/S/chan.
  • Dispatch: n == 40 -> F40; n < 41: index n-10 into the halfword tbh table at 0x08012e3e (n-10 > 29, i.e. n < 10 or 40+ not handled, returns silently); 41-52 switch(n-41); 53, 54, 60-64, 112 explicit; everything else returns with NO reply.
  • Reply: sprintf into a stack buffer, then FUN_08019e50: if TX-busy flag 0x20000106 is 0 (previous reply finished), PA11 high, sprintf("%s") into 0x200011c8, strlen (low 8 bits), DMA TX (FUN_08015bac sets busy 1). If a previous reply is still being sent the new reply is dropped. The DMA TX-complete ISR drops PA11 low and clears busy. Replies are sent immediately when the command is parsed (motion is not waited for).
  • Every reply string below is exact, including spaces. <CRLF> = \r\n.

State 5: C=1 -> state 10, C=2 -> 0x15, C=3 -> 0x20, C=4 -> 0x2b, reply F10 ok. FFS channel N feeding.; other C: F10 ok. FFS channel not exist. every reply ends with space + , e.g. F10 ok. F52 CHOPCONF (0x6c) feed, 0x2000022c F52 ok.CHOPCONF: ... F54 PWMCONF (0x70) feed, 0x20000230 F54 ok.PWMCONF: ... Else (0x20000098 = 1, i.e. between a driver-reset event and the post-homing 0x7f) nothing changes, reply F112 ok. error. no space before CRLF F46-F49, F55-F59, F65-F111, F113+, F0-F9 no reply
